sa: शोकस्थानसहस्राणि हर्षस्थानशतानि च। दिवसे दिवसे मूढमाविशन्ति न पण्डितम्॥
en: There are thousands of causes for sorrow and hundreds of causes for joy. These affect daily the ignorant only, but not the wise.

sa: प्रणिपत्य ततस्ते तु विधिवद् राजपुङ्गवा उदमूचुर्वचो राजन् कार्तिकेयप्रियेप्सया॥ अस्य बालस्य भगवन्नाधिपत्यं यथेप्सितम्। अस्मात्प्रियार्थं देवेश सदृशं दातुमर्हसि॥
en: Having duly bowed into him, they said these words, O king, from desire of doing god unto Kartikeya:-"O Lord of the gods, for the sake of our happiness you should give this youth some kind of sovereignty that may suit him and that he may desire.'

sa: भीमसेनमभिद्रुत्य रुरुधुः सर्वतोदिशम्। ततो भीमो महाराज स्वरथं पुनरास्थितः॥
en: Then Bhima, O monarch, once more getting on his own car, began to shoot keen arrows at the vital limbs of your sons.

sa: इत्येवं वदमानास्ते हर्षेण महता युता। प्रभग्नांस्तावकान्योधान् संहृष्टा पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः॥
en: Saying these words and filled with joy, the Srinjayas pursued your soldiers in that battle who had been exceedingly wounded with arrows. as

sa: वन्दनार्हविमौ तस्य बन्दिभिर्वन्दितौ शुभौ। गोमायवो विकर्षन्ति पादौ शिष्यशतार्चितौ॥
en: His auspicious feet, worthy of adoration and adored before by bards and eulogists, and worshipped by disciples, are now being dragged by jackals.

sa: ततः प्रदीप्तलाङ्गुलः सविद्युदिव तोयदः। भवनाग्रेषु लङ्काया विचचार महाकपिः॥
en: Thereat that mighty monkey, with his tail aglow, and resembling a cloud (luminous) with lightning, began to range before the dwellings in Lankā.

sa: सूर्यः प्रतपतां श्रेष्ठो द्विपदां ब्राह्मणो वरः। आशीविषश्च सर्पाणामग्निस्तेजस्विनां वरः॥ आयुधानां वरं वज्रं ककुद्मी च गवां वरः। ह्रदानामुदधिः श्रेष्ठः पर्जन्यो वर्षतां वरः॥ धृतराष्ट्रश्च नागानां हस्तिष्वैरावणो वरः। पुत्रः प्रियाणामधिको भार्या च सुहृदां वरा॥ यथैतानि विशिष्टानि जात्यां जात्यां वृकोदर। एवं युवा गुडाकेश: श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: The sun is the foremost of all shining bodies, the Brahmana is the foremost of all bipeds, the Ashivisha is the foremost of all serpents, the fire is the foremost of all bright substances, thunder is the foremost of all weapons, the humped bull is the foremost of its kind, the ocean is the foremost of all watery expanses, the Parjanya is the foremost of all rain clouds, Dhritarashtra is the foremost of all Nagas, Airavata is the foremost of all elephants, the son is the foremost of all beloved objects, and the wife is the foremost of all friends. O Vrikodara, as every species has its, best, so is the youthful Gudakesha the best of all archers.

sa: तेषामापततां तूर्णं गाण्डीवप्रेषितैः शरैः। शिरांसि पातयामास बाहूंश्चापि धनंजयः॥
en: Then as they made quickly towards himself, Dhananjaya, with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow, began to cut down their heads and arms.

sa: उत्तरं नहि वक्तव्यं ज्येष्ठेनाभिहिते पुनः। अधर्मसहितं चैव परलोकविवर्जितम्॥
en: But, albeit this course is unrighteous and entails perdition, yet desired by an eldest brother, I certainly ought not to make any answer.

sa: षड्भिरन्यैश्च सहितो भास्करः प्रतपिष्यति। तुमुलाश्चापि निर्झदा दिग्दाहाश्चापि सर्वशः॥
en: The sun will appear with six other suns. There will be great noise on every side and everywhere there will be (great) conflagrations.

sa: तस्मिन् हते महामात्रे पञ्चालानां महारथे। अपायाज्जवनैरश्वैर्दोणात् त्रस्तो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: When that mighty car-warrior the leader of the Panchalas was slain, Yudhishthira being afraid of Drona, fled away, being borne by fleet steeds.

sa: रामचिन्तामयः शोको भरतस्य महात्मनः। उपस्थितो ह्यनर्हस्य धर्मप्रेक्षस्य तादृशः॥
en: Then arose thoughts of Rāma in the mind of the magnanimous Bharata ever having his gaze fixed on virtue and undeserving (of hardship).

sa: ततोऽहंधनुरादाय तथाक्षय्ये महेषुधी। अताडयं शरेणाथ तद् भूतं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Then, taking up my bow and two inexhaustible quivers, I pierced that creature, causing the hair stand on the end, with an arrow.

sa: ब्राह्यं तेजस्तदाजय्यं मन्यमानो महारथः। अपरस्मिन् वनोद्देशे वीरौ शल्यवृकोदरौ॥
en: On another part of the field the mighty hcroes Shalya and Vrikodara (Bhima) endued with great strength, well skilled in battle and learning,

sa: सुचिरेणार्जिताँल्लोकान् सद्यो युद्धात् समश्रुते। तस्य तद् वचनं राज्ञः पूजयित्वा महारथाः॥ पुनरेवामभ्यवर्तन्त क्षत्रियाः पाण्डवान् प्रति। पराजयममृष्यन्तः कृतचित्ताश्च विक्रमे॥
en: The warrior acquires in a day the blissful regions of the other world that take many long years for others to acquire."-Obeying those words of the king, Kshatriya car-warriors once more rushed against the Pandavas, unable to put up with their discomfiture and firinly resolved to display their prowess.

sa: सुवर्णमालिनो युपाश्चैत्याश्चाप्यतिभास्वराः। ददौ यत्र सहस्राणि प्रयुतानि च केशवः॥
en: Where Keshava placed thousands and tens of thousands of sacrificial stakes adorned with garlands of gold and innumerable (sacrificial) altars of great splendour.

sa: त्वमेव दैवतैः सर्वैः पृच्छसे धर्मसंशयात्। अतस्त्वं देवदेवानामाधिपत्ये प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: All the gods ask you to remove their doubts in religion, and for this reason, O lord, you have been elected their king.

sa: रामास्त्रविद्धो घोरं वै नर्दन्राक्षसपुङ्गवः। अभ्यधावत तं क्रुद्धो हरीन्विद्रावयन्रणे॥
en: On being frightfully pierced by Rāma's weapons, that foremost of Rākşasas roaring wrathfully darted against Rāma, and pursued the monkeys in the conflict.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् द्रौपदी योषितां वरा॥ चिन्तामवाप परमामन्नहेतोः पतिव्रता।
en: In the interval, O king, Draupadi, the best of women ever devoted to her husband, began to think how she could provide food.

sa: हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु वीतहव्यः सुतेष्वथा प्राद्रवन्नगरं हित्वा भृगोराश्रममप्युत॥
en: After all his warriors and sons had been killed in battle, king Vitahavya fled away from his capital to the hermitage of Bhrigu.

sa: अद्य ते भिन्नकण्ठस्य फेनबुबुदभूषितम्। विदारितस्य मद्बाणैर्मही पास्यति शोणितम्॥
en: To day the earth shall drink the blood vitiated with foamy bubbles, of you, having your throat severed, and riven by my shafts.

sa: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने। पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः॥
en: O slayer of hostile heroes, you alone are quite competent to perform this task; and you shall attain fame through your rising prowess.

sa: यच्चाहं पाण्डुपुत्रेषु गुणवत्सु महात्मसु॥ न दत्तवाश्रियं दीप्तां पितृपैतामहीमिमाम्।
en: I also repent for not having bestowed that blazing prosperity, derived from sires and grandsires on the great Pandavas possessed of every accomplishment.

sa: तथैव भीमसेनोऽपि धर्मराजेन पूजितः। प्रायात् सात्यकिना सार्धभिवाद्य युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Set out with Satyaki, after having duly saluted the king (Yudhishthira). Beholding these two scorchers of foes cast their glances on your army.

sa: सूतपुत्रस्तु संक्रुद्धो लघुहस्तः प्रतापवान्॥ घटोत्कचमतिक्रम्य बिभेद दशभिः शरैः।
en: Thereupon the light-handed and puissant son of Suta excited to the highest pitch of fury, prevailing over Ghatotkacha, pierced him with ten shafts.

sa: अनयन् परलोकाय शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। शरैश्च विविधैर्पोरैस्तत्र तत्र विशाम्पते॥ रथास्तु रथिभि_ना हतसारथयस्तथा। विप्रदुताश्चाः समरे दिशो जग्मुः समन्ततः॥
en: Conveyed one another to the abode of Death, with their straight knotted shafts; and in that field of battle, O ruler of men, many cars deprived of their riders with numerous dreadful arrows, and with their drivers slain, careered on the being dragged on all sides.

sa: स निगृह्यात्मनो दुःखं दह्यमानो महीपतिः। वाष्पसंदिग्धया वाचा पुनरेवेदपद्रवीत्॥
en: Having suppressed his grief and burning with sorrow, the lord of the earth uttered again these words in a voice choked with tears.

sa: इति तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच समाहितः। मधुरैः प्रसृतैर्वार्यहेतुमद्भिरनिष्ठुरैः॥
en: Hearing these words of theirs the jackal replied to them, with rapt attention, in these sweet and reasonable words, inculcating harmlessness to all-

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं प्रदीप्तांनलवर्चसम्। विस्फारयामास तदा कार्मुकं पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: That best of persons, seeing that foremost of Rākṣasas having the splendour of a living fire, stretched his bow to its full bent.

sa: दन्तिनश्च नरश्रेष्ठ हीनाः परमसादिभिः। मृदन्तः स्वान्यनीकानि निपेतुः सर्वशब्दगाः॥
en: Huge tusked elephants also, O foremost of men, deprived of their excellent riders, fell down crushing their own ranks and uttering distressful cries,

sa: ते हयैः काञ्चनापीडैर्गजैश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः। रथैश्चादित्यसंकाशैः कवचैश्च मनोरमैः॥ निर्ययू राक्षसा वीरा नादयन्तो दिशो दश। राक्षसा भीमकर्माणो रावणस्य जयैषिणः॥
en: And furnished with steeds in golden trappings, and elephants resembling flames of fire; and cars appearing like (so many) suns; and shining armour, the valiant Räkşasas issued, making the ten cardinal points resound. The Rākşasas of terrific exploits were burning for victory on behalf of Rāvana.

sa: अत्यन्तशत्रुरस्माकं येन दुःशासनः क्षिप्रं ह्यभिमुखः संख्ये विसंज्ञो विमुखीकृतः॥
en: Our implacable enemy Dushasana having encountered him in battle, was quickly compelled by his shafts to retreat, being nearly deprived of his senses.

sa: ते विषण्णमुखा दीनाः प्रहारजनितश्रमाः। विनेदुरुच्चैर्बहवः सहसा विस्वरैः स्वरैः॥
en: And with pale forces and distressed, they, fatigued in consequence of the thrashing they had undergone, suddenly began to cry in frightful accents.

sa: न चैनानन्वबुध्यन्त मनुजा मनुजोत्तम। एवं प्रवृत्तान् दैत्यांस्तांस्तापसेषु तपस्विषु॥
en: O foremost of men, the Danavas acted in this way towards the ascetics in their ascetic retreats. Yet men could not discover them.

sa: आश्रमे यो द्विजं हन्याद् गां वा दद्यादनाश्रमे। किं तु तत्पातकं न स्यात् तद्वा दत्तं वृथा भवेत्॥
en: If one, while following a particular mode of life, kills a Brahmana, will not the sin of Brahmanicide assail him? If, on the other hand, one gives away a cow, while not even following any particular mode of life, will that pious gift yields on merit?

sa: विशेषयिष्यशिष्यं च द्रोणो राजन् पराक्रमी। अदृश्यमर्जुनं चक्रे निमेषाच्छरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thus, O monarch, the puissant Drona, worsting his disciple within a moment, caused Arjuna to disappear from the view, with his arrowy showers.

sa: स संनिववृते श्रुत्वा धर्मराजस्य भाषितम्। देवदूतोऽब्रवीच्चैनमेतावद् गमनं तव॥
en: Hearing these words of king Yudhishthira, the just, the celestial messenger stopped in his course and replied, saying, Thus far is your way.

sa: चरन्तौ विविधान् मार्गान् हार्दिक्यशिनिपुङ्गवौ। मुहुरन्तर्दधाते तौ बाणवृष्ट्या परस्परम्॥
en: Moving about in various ways the son of Hridika and that foremost of Shini's race soon covered each other with showers of arrows.

sa: इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमागतम्। व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम्॥
en: O foremost of men, for the preservation of earth, you have given vent to words, without any hesitation, pregnant with manliness and piety.

sa: अनाहता दुन्दुभयः प्रणदन्ति विशाम्पते। अयुक्ताश्च प्रवर्तन्ते क्षत्रियाणां महारथाः॥
en: O king, drums without being beaten give out sounds. The great cars of the Kshatriyas move, though no animals are yoked to them.

sa: मान्यानां तत्र वृद्धानां कृत्वा पादाभिवादनम्। वनानि क्रमशस्तात सर्वाण्येवाभ्यगच्छत॥
en: O son, there bowing down to the feet of the elders and the revered, she visited all the forests one after the other.

sa: पश्यतो भीमसेनस्य विजयस्याच्युतस्य च। यमयोधर्मपुत्रस्य पार्षतस्य च पश्यतः॥
en: Even before the very sight of Bhimsena and Achyuta and the twins and the virtuous Yudhishthira and the son of Prishata. some SO

sa: स तां पुष्करिणीं गत्वा पद्मोत्पलझषाकुलाम्। रामः सौमित्रिसहितो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः॥
en: Repairing with Lakşmaņa to the lake Pampā filled with red and while lotuses and fish Rāma having his senses agitated began to lament.

sa: हताश्वं च समालक्ष्य हतसूतमरिंदम॥ अभ्यधावत् कृपो राजञ्जिघांसुः शिनिपुङ्गवम्।
en: Beholding that chastiser of foes made steedless and driverless, Kripa, O king, rushed at that best of Shini's race, desirous of killing him.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा भारद्वाजं महारथम्। सात्यकिः पञ्चविंशत्या क्षुद्रकाणां समार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki pierced with five and twenty short arrows that mighty car-warrior the son of Bharadvaja, who had been advancing furiously against him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ययाति: स्वपुरं प्राप्य महेन्द्रपुरसंनिभम्। प्रविश्यान्तःपुरं तत्र देवयानी न्यवेशयत्॥ देवयान्याश्चानुमते सुतां तां वृषपर्वणः। अशोकवनिकाभ्याशे गृहं कृत्वा न्यवेशयत्॥ वृतां दासीसहस्रेण शर्मिष्ठां वार्षपर्वणीम्। वासोभिरन्नपानैश्च संविभज्य सुसत्कृताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Yayati, then coming to his capital which was like that of Indra, entered the innerapartment and installed Devayani there. At the request of Devayani, he established the daughter of Vrishaparva in a house which he caused to be erected in the Ashoka groves of his gardens. The king honoured the daughter of Vrishaparva, Sharmishtha, surrounded by her one thousand maids, by making every arrangement for her food and garments.

sa: शरणैषिपरित्यागं कथं साध्विति मन्यसे। आहारार्थं समारम्भस्तव चायं विहंगम॥
en: O bird, why do you consider, it virtuous to forsake one who seeks one's protection? Your attempt is only to search for food.

sa: युधिष्ठिरश्च भीमश्च यमौ कृष्णस्तथापरे॥ आसन् सुव्रीडिता राजन् सात्यकिस्त्वब्रवीदिदम्।
en: Yudhishthira and Bhima and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) and Krishna himself were overwhelmed with shame, o king. Then Satyaki spoke these words-

sa: तदाप्रभृति काकुत्स्थ पितृदेवाः समागताः। अफलान् भुञ्जते मेपान् फलैस्तेपामयोजयन्॥
en: Thence forth, O Kākutstha, the divine Pitrs together feast upon scrotumless rams, for their scrotum had been joined to the person of Indra.

sa: बुभुक्षितः शोणितमांसगृध्नुः प्रविश्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम्। चखाद रक्षांसि हरॆन्पिशाचान्नृक्षांश्च मोहाधुधि कुम्भकर्णः।। यथैव मृत्युहरते युगान्ते स भक्षयामास हरीश्च मुख्यान्॥
en: On entering the mighty host of monkeys, the hungry Kumbhakarna, hankering after flesh and blood, ate up the monkeys and with them, devoured many a Rākşasa and Piśāca by, mistake. Thus, as Death devour creatures at the end of a Yuga, he destroyed the mighty monkeys.

sa: इहैव त्वाभिषिञ्चन्तु सर्वाः प्रकृतयः सह। ऋत्विजः सवसिष्ठाश्च मन्त्रविन्मन्त्रकोविदाः॥
en: Even here, O you cognizant of the Mantras, let all the subjects and the Rtvijas with Vasiștha, versed in the Mantras, install you.

sa: प्रविशैतद् बलं तात धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः। प्रविश्य च यथान्यायं संगम्य च महारथैः। यथार्हमात्मनः कर्म रणे सात्वत दर्शय॥
en: Do you, O sire, penetrate into this army of the wicked-minded sons of Dhritarashtra. Entering into it and meeting duly with mighty car-warrior in. battle, display ( you of the Satvata race, the feats that you are capable of achieving and that are worthy of yourself.

sa: त्रिदण्डधारणं मौनं जटाभारोऽथ मुण्डनम्। वल्कलाजिन संवेष्टं व्रतचर्याभिषेचनम्॥ अग्निहोत्रं वने वासः शरीरपरिशोषणम्। सर्वाण्येतानि मिथ्या स्युर्यदि भावो न निर्मलः॥
en: Carrying of the three stays, the vow of silence, matted locks (on head), shaving of the head, wearing barks and deer skins, observing vows, practicing ablutions, worshipping of fire and living in the forest emaciating the body, all these are useless to one if his heart be not pure.

sa: अमावस्यां तु सहिता ऋषयः संशितव्रताः। ब्रह्मणं द्रष्टुकामास्ते सम्प्रतस्थुर्महर्षयः॥
en: On a new moon day the Rishis of rigid vows assembled together and were about to start with the desire of seeing Brahma.

sa: ज्ञानानि चाप्यविज्ञाय करिष्यन्ति क्रियास्तथा। आत्मच्छन्देन वर्तन्ते युगान्ते समुपस्थिते॥
en: When this age would come, men will perform the ceremonies and rites without knowing the ordinances; they will behave as they would like.

sa: गृहीत्वामरगर्भाभं पुत्रं कमललोचनम्। आजगाम ततः सुभूर्दुष्यन्तं विदिताद् वनात्॥
en: That beauty of fair eye-brows, taking her lotus-eyed son of celestial beauty with her, left the forest where she had first met Dushyanta.

sa: शूद्राधर्मं प्रवक्ष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाः पर्युपासकाः। श्रोतारश्च भविष्यन्ति प्रामाण्येन व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: The Shudras will explain religion, Brahmanas will listen to them and settle their duties by accepting such interpretations (as made by the Shudras).

sa: चकार बहुधाऽऽत्मानं भीषयाणो महारथान्॥ ततो दिग्भ्यः समापेतुः सिंहव्याघ्रतरक्षवः। अग्निजिह्वाश्च भुजगा विहगाश्चाप्ययोमुखाः॥ स कीर्यमाणो विशिखैः कर्णचापच्युतैः शरैः।
en: Multiplied himself many times thereby inspiring terror in to the hearts of mighty carwarriors. Thereafter from all the points of the compass lions, tigers, hyenas, fire-tongued snakes and iron-beaked rangers of the sky, began to issue out. Covered with the swiftlyflying arrows shot from Karna's bow.

sa: यत्रानयामास तदा राजसूयं महीपते। पुत्रोऽदितेर्महाभागो वरुणो वै सितप्रभः॥
en: The highly effulgent and blessed son of Aditi, Varuna, had in days of yore performed in that Tirtha the Rajasuya sacrifice, O king.

sa: कालिकानिलवेगेन महोदधिरिवोत्थितः। रामे वनं प्रव्रजिते नगरं प्रचचाल तत्॥
en: And clouds driven by the wind resembled the sea mounting the welkin; and the city shook on Rāma having departed for the forest.

sa: बलिरुवाच अनित्यमुपलक्ष्येह कालपर्यायधर्मतः। तस्माच्छक न शोचामि सर्वं ह्येवेदमन्तवत्॥
en: Vali said Regarding all this as transitory,-due, indeed, to the course of time,-I do not, O Shakra, grieve. These things have an end.

sa: इत्यजल्पन् महाराज परानीकविनाशनम्। देशे देशे मनुष्याश्च कीचकं दुष्प्रधर्षणम्॥
en: It is in this way, O great king, that people of various countries spoke about the irrepressible Kichaka, the slayer of hostile armies.

sa: तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां प्रातरुत्थाय कीचकः। गत्वा राजकुलायैव द्रौपदीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: That night being passed, Kichaka rose up in the morning, and having gone to the royal house, addressed Draupadi in the following terms.

sa: स्वमन्त्रमभिसंधाय तस्यार्थमनुचिन्त्य च। उद्योगं चैव कृष्णायाः सुदेष्णा सूतमब्रवीत्॥
en: Holding counsel with her own self and pondering over his desire and over the perturbation of Krishna, Sudeshna said to Suta's son (Kichaka).

sa: गोष्टमासाद्य तिष्ठन्तं भवनस्य समीपतः। राजाथ दृष्ट्वा पुरुषान् प्राहिणोज्जातविस्मयः॥
en: Then the king, seeing him standing in the cow pasture in the vicinity of the royal palace, became amazed and sent for him.

sa: ततोऽनुव्रज्य गोविन्दं धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। राज्ञां सकाशे द्युतिमानुवाचेदं वचस्तदा॥
en: And the just king Yudhishthira, endued with luster, having followed Govinda to some distance, said these words in the midst of those kings.

sa: ततो विराटमूचुस्ते कीचकोऽस्याः कृते हतः। सहानेनाद्य दह्येम तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: Then they said to Virata: "For her, Kichaka has been slain; we shall burn her with him; it behoves you to give permission.”

sa: स्वलंकृताश्च कल्याण्यः पादैरेव सहस्रशः। वारमुख्या महाभागं प्रत्युद्यास्यन्ति केशवम्॥
en: Blessed damsels, the foremost among dancing girls, by thousands with ornaments on will go out on foot to receive Keshava of large parts.

sa: पापस्यास्य नृशंसस्य त्यक्तधर्मस्य दुर्मतेः। नोत्सहेऽनर्थसंयुक्ताः श्रोतुं वाचः कथंचन॥
en: I dare not listen to any words of this man of wicked purpose, who has abandoned virtue and who is cruel and sinful.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पृथामामन्त्र्य गोविन्दः कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। दुर्योधनगृहं शौरिरभ्यगच्छदरिंदमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Bidding adieu to Pritha and also going round her, Govinda or Shauri, the chastiser of enemies, went the residence of Duryodhana.

sa: दुर्योधनसमीपे तानासनस्थान् ददर्श सः। अभ्यागच्छति दाशार्हे धार्तराष्ट्रो महायशाः॥
en: He saw them on a seat near Duryodhana. The scion of the Dasharha race, having appeared, the son of Dhritarashtra of great fame.

sa: एकाचं चिन्तयिष्यामि पीत्वा वेत्स्यामि वा जलम्। स्यात् तु दुर्योधनेनेदमुपांशुविहितं कृतम्॥ गान्धारराजरचितं सततं जिह्मबुद्धिना। यस्य कार्यमकार्यं वा सममेव भवत्युत॥ कस्तस्य विश्वसेद् वीरो दुष्कृतेकृतात्मनः। अथवा पुरुषैर्गुढैः प्रयोगोऽयं दुरात्मनः॥
en: I will reflect on this with concentration or I will try to know of it after drinking water. Perhaps the crooked-minded Duryodhana with whom good and evil are alike has got it (the tark) destruc.ive of life, made by the king of Gandhara. What cool-headed person can trust that wicked minded man ever bent on evil deeds? Or perhaps that wicked souled one has caused it to be made by some secret messengers of his."

sa: धनुश्च्युतै रुक्मपुङ्खैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। द्विषतां भिन्ध्यनीकानि गजानामिव युथपः॥
en: Crush down the enemics' life, with straight shafts feathered in gold discharged off your bow like an elephant chief rushing at a herd.

sa: जारासंधिः सहदेवो जयत्सेनश्च तावुभौ। युद्धेऽप्रतिस्थौ वीरौ पाण्डवार्थं व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: The son of Jarasandha, Sahadeva and Jayatsena, both of whom are unrivaled heroes in battle, are present in the cause of the Pandavas.

sa: नमस्कृत्योपजग्मुस्ते लोकवृद्धं पितामहम्। परिवार्य च विश्वेशं पर्यासत दिवौकसः॥
en: Having saluted to that old grandsire of the universe, approached him and the dwellers of heaven sat round that lord of the universe.

sa: बृहस्पतिश्चोशना च ब्रह्माणं पर्युपस्थितौ। मरुतश्च सहेन्द्रेण वसवश्चाग्निना सह॥
en: (Once on a time) Brihaspati along with Shakra went to Brahma, as also did thc Maruta with Indra and the Vasus with Agni.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमादीनि वाक्यानि विलपन्तमचेतसम्। प्रहस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रो रथस्यान्तिकमानयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Holding him forcibly who was bewailing in these strains being beside himself that foremost of men brought him near the car.

sa: यस्मादलं समस्तास्ताः पतन्ति जलमूर्तयः। तस्मात् पातालमित्येव ख्यायते पुरमुत्तमम्॥
en: Since all those objects, having the form of water, fall on it; therefore is this excellent region known by the name of Patalam.

sa: नैवंविधं मया युक्तमालब्धु क्षत्रयोनिना। महता राजपुत्रेण मन्त्रयज्ञविदा सता॥
en: To touch it does not become me who am born in the Kshatriya race, a mighty prince and observant of Mantras and vows.

sa: इह नानाविधाकारा नानाविधविभूषणाः। सुरसायाः सुता नागा निवसन्ति गतव्यथाः॥
en: Here live, passed the reach of pain, the sons of Surasa, Nagas, of many species and sizes and with diverse sorts of ornaments.

sa: अनेन तपसा वेद्मि सर्वं परचिकीर्षितम्। सत्यमेतन्निबोधध्वं ध्रियते सत्यवानिति॥
en: By virtue of this asceticism I am aware of the doings of other people. Know this to be certain that Satyavana is alive.

sa: यद्येष राजा मत्स्यानां यदि बीभत्सुरागतः। अहमावारयिष्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: If he be the king of Matsya's or Bibhatsu that has come I shall resist him as the banks resist the waving sea.

sa: नक्तंचराचरन्त्येते हृष्टाः क्रूराभिभाषिणः। श्रूयन्ते पर्णशब्दाश्च मृगाणां चरतां वने॥
en: The night-wandering creatures of harsh voices are joyfully roving about. And the rustling of leaves consequent on the footsteps of beasts are heard.

sa: गुर्वर्थो दीयतामेष यदि गालव मन्यसे। इत्येवमाह सक्रोधो विश्वामित्रस्तपोधनः॥
en: Make this present to your spiritual guide if you think fit, O Galava. Thus did the great ascetic Vishvamitra address him in anger.

sa: अवैधव्याशिषस्ते तु सावित्र्यर्थं हिताः शुभाः। ऊचुस्तपस्विनः सर्वे तपोवननिवासिनः॥
en: And all the ascetics living in the hermitage pronounced, for the welfare of Savitri, the benediction that she might never be a widow.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यानेवाहुरिज्यया साधुलोकान् द्विजातीनां पुण्यतमान् सनातनान्। तेषां परार्थं कथयन्तीह वेदा एतद् विद्वान् नोपैति कथं नु कर्म॥
en: Dhritarashtra said The blessed regions, highly sacred and eternal, to which, it is said, the twice-born can go by the performance of sacrificial ceremonies, are declared by the Vedas of offer emancipation to mortals. Having got this knowledge why should not learned man engage in acts in this world.

sa: अपि नो व्यसनं घोरं दुर्योधनकृतं महत्। शमयेच्चिररात्राय योगक्षेमवदव्ययम्॥
en: If she can thwart this dire and frightful calamity brought about by Duryodhana then shall we attain happiness and remain happy for ever.

sa: प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा पार्थः शरशतैः कृपम्। स शरैरर्दितः क्रुद्धः शितैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥
en: Covering the entire sky with his arrows, that powerful warrior of exceeding energy, the son of Pritha assailed Kripa with hundreds of shafts.

sa: इदमम्भः कुबेरस्ते महाराजः प्रयच्छति। अन्तर्हितानां भूतानां दर्शनार्थं परंतप॥
en: O chastiser of foes, Kubera, the king of kings has sent you this water in order that you may behold all invisible beings.

sa: ततः सुतुमुलं युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम्। दूषणानुजयोः पार्थ लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः॥
en: Then, O Partha, there ensued an awfullyterrible encounter, making the hair stand erect, between the younger brothers of Dushana and the intelligent Lakshmana.

sa: तस्य चैतत्प्रदानस्य फलमद्यानुपश्यसि। यद् भुड्क्षे पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना शूरैर्निहतकण्टकाम्॥
en: The fruits of this bestowal you now seeyou enjoy this entire earth, subjected by those heroes, with all your thorns and barriers removed.

sa: ते ततोऽभिपततां तेषामदृश्यानां दुरात्मनाम्। अन्तर्धानवधं तज्ज्ञश्चकार स विभीषणः॥
en: And remaining invisible, as those wickedsouled creatures were thus stealthily entering, Vibhishana, knew all this and did away with their power of invisibility.

sa: स मन्युवशमापन्नः पार्थमभ्यद्रवद् रणे। किरज्छरसहस्राणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्॥
en: Then possessed by wrath, he encountered Partha in battle and discharged at him a downpour of arrows like clouds discharging their watery contents.

sa: द्वितीयसागरनिभं तद् बलं बहुलध्वजम्। वेलावनं समासाद्य निवासमकरोत् तदा॥
en: And that (vast) army which looked like a second ocean furnished with innumerable standards reached the shores of the sea) and encamped there.

sa: मुखमासीत् तु सैन्यस्य हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः। जघनं पालयामास सौमित्रितरकुतोभयः॥
en: Hanuman, the son of Pavana marched in the van of the army while its rear was protected by the dauntless son of Sumitra.

sa: षष्टिकोटिसहरू णि प्रकर्षन् प्रत्यदृश्यत। गोलाङ्गलो महाराज गवाक्षो भीमदर्शनः॥
en: O mighty monarch, the terrible-looking Gavakshya having the tail of a cow, came thither, after having collected six hundred billions (of monkeys). one

sa: सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेणाभिपालितौ। कुशलं त्वाब्रवीद् रामः सीते सौमित्रिणा सह॥
en: Being well cared for by Sugriva and the monkeys. O Sita, both Rama and the son of Sumitra have enquired of your welfare.

sa: जटिला मलदिग्धाङ्गी कृशा दीना तपस्विनी। निमित्तैस्तामहं सीतामुपलभ्य पृथग्विधैः॥
en: With clotted hair, covered with dirt, melancholy, lean and lank and devoted to asceticism. Knowing her to be Sita by these unusual signs,

sa: दारुणो ह्येष दुष्टात्मा क्षुद्रकर्मा निशाचरः। स्वभावाच्छीलदोषेण सर्वेषां भयवर्धनः॥
en: This night-ranger is terribly wicked-minded and is prone to mean deeds and on account of his innate bad nature he terrifies all (creatures).

sa: न वै तेषां स्वदते पथ्यमुक्तं योगक्षेमं कल्पते नैव तेषाम्। भिन्नानां वै मनुजेन्द्र परायणं न विद्यते किंचिदन्यद् विनाशात्॥
en: They are not pleased with what is spoken for their benefit; they cannot get hat they do not possess; nor they can retain what they have. O chief among men, there is no other end of those that are not in good terms with their blood relations save destruction.

sa: सस्त्रीकुमारैः कुरुभिः पूज्यमाना महारथाः। बभ्राजिरे महात्मानः क्रतुमध्ये यथाग्नयः॥
en: Those illustrious car-warriors, worshipped by the Kurus with their sons and wives, blazed forth in splendour, as a fire blazes in a sacrifice.

sa: नियन्तारमसाधूनां गोप्तारं धर्मचारिणाम्। ईदृशं क्षत्रिया सूते वीरं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥
en: Subjugator of the disreputable, a protector of those that practice virtues, such a son of true prowess does a Kshatriya lady bring forth.

sa: यदि सन्तं सेवति सद्यसन्तं तपस्विनं यदि वा स्तेनमेवा वासो यथा रङ्गवशं प्रयाति तथा स तेषां वशमभ्युपैति॥
en: According as a man serves a saint or as he is wicked or virtuous or a thief, so he becomes endued with the habits of his associates; even as a cloth comes to be of the same colour with the die in which it is soaked.

sa: कर्णिनालीकनाराचान् निर्हरन्ति शरीरतः। वाक्शल्यस्तु न निर्हर्तुं शक्यो हृदिशयोहिसः॥
en: Arrows and darts can be extracted from the body; but the darts of words cannot be extracted from the depth of the heart.

sa: इति तद् राजवचनं प्रतिश्रुत्याथ मन्थरा। कैकेयीमभिगम्येदं काले वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these words of the king, Manthara (the maid of Kaikeyi) went to Kaikeyi and addressed her these words suited to the occasion.

sa: अप्युन्मत्तात् प्रलपतो बालाच्च परिजल्पतः। सर्वतः सारमादद्यादश्मभ्य इव काञ्चनम्॥
en: Enlightenment should be sought for from everything-even from the leavings of a lunatic and the prattles of a child, as gold from stones.

sa: गत्वा देवर्षिगन्धर्वैः सहितोऽथ बृहस्पतिः। पुराणैः कर्मभिर्देवं तुष्टाव बलसूदनम्॥
en: Brihaspati, then having gone (there) along with the Devarshis and Gandharvas, propitiated the slayer of Bala by reciting his deeds of olden days.

sa: पञ्च त्वानुगमिष्यन्ति यत्र यत्र गमिष्यसि। मित्राण्यमित्रा मध्यस्था उपजीव्योपजीविनः॥
en: These five follow you wherever you go viz., friends, those that are neither, dependents nor those who ought to be supported by you.

sa: स्वस्रीयो वासुदेवस्य साक्षाद् देवशिशुर्यथा। दयितश्चक्रहस्तस्य सर्वास्त्रेषु च कोविदः॥
en: A nephew of Vasudeva, like a very celestials boy-my son, who has mastered all weapons, is the favourite of the holder of discus.

sa: तथैव सर्वधर्मज्ञः पितुर्मम पितामहः। प्रतीपः पृथिवीपालस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः॥
en: Thus also the grandfather of my father, conversant with all virtues, Pratipa the ruler of the universe and known in the three worlds,

sa: अपि नाम वरारोहा मामेषा लोकसुन्दरी। भजेदद्यायतापाङ्गी सुदती तनुमध्यमा॥
en: was Will this most excellent beauty of the world, this slender-waisted lady, having beautiful teeth and large eyes, accept me as her lord?

sa: कूपाश्च विविधाकारा मनोहर्षविवर्धनाः। वाष्यश्च विविधाकारा औदकानि गृहाणि च॥
en: And he (provided) wells of various shapes calculated to increase the cheerfulness of the heart and several sorts of streams, fountains and buildings.

sa: सात्यकिश्चेकितानश्च भीमसेनश्च वीर्यवान्। एते सेनाप्रणेतारो वीराः सर्वे तनुज्यजः॥
en: Satyaki, Chekitana and Bhimasena endued with strength, these heroes who are prepared to sacrifice their lives will be the commanders of my army.

sa: ममाप्येते महाराज भवद्भिर्य उदाहृताः। नेतारस्तव सेनाया मता विक्रान्तयोधिनः॥
en: In my opinion too, O great king, these powerful warriors who have been named by you, should be the leaders of your army.

sa: नातप्ततपसः पुंसो नामहायज्ञयाजिनः। नानृता नास्तिकाश्चैव तत्र गच्छन्ति मुद्गल॥
en: O sage, atheists and untruthful persons, those that have not performed asceticism and those that have not performed great sacrifices, cannot go there.

sa: उपप्लव्ये तु पाञ्चाली द्रौपदी सत्यवादिनी। सह स्त्रीभिर्निववृते दासीदाससमावृता॥
en: The truthful princess of Panchali, the daughter of Drupada in company with other ladies and surrounded by servant and maids remained at Upaplavya.

sa: तेऽवगाह्य कुरुक्षेत्रं शङ्खान् दध्मुररिंदमाः। तथैव दध्मतुः शङ्ख वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: And reaching Kurukshetra those chastiser of foes blew their conches and in the same way did Vasudeva and Dhananjaya also blow their conches.

sa: शिबिरं मापयामास धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। सात्यकिश्च रथोदारो युयुधानश्चः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the son of the Prishata race, and the car-warrior Satyaki endued with prowess, otherwise called Yuyudhana, had the land of encampment measured.

sa: व्यथयेयुरिमे देवान् सेन्द्रानपि समागमे। पाण्डवा वासुदेवश्च विराटद्रुपदौ तथा॥
en: These assembled together would strike terror into the hearts of the gods even with Indra-namely the son of Pandu Vasudeva, Virata and Drupada,

sa: ऋते सेनाप्रणेतारं पृतना सुमहत्यपि। दीर्यते युद्धमासाद्य पिपीलिकपुटं यथा॥
en: “Without a (suitable) leader of the army even a large army is broken up when engaged in battle like a swarm of ants.

sa: रश्मिवतामिवादित्यो वीस्थामिव चन्द्रमाः। कुबेर इव यक्षाणां देवानामिव वासवः॥
en: You are as the sun is among the luminous bodies, the moon among deciduous herbs, Kubera among the Yakshas, Vasava among the gods,

sa: महासुरे हतः शक्र नमुचिर्दारुणस्त्वया। शम्बरच बलश्चैव तथोभौ घोरविक्रमौ॥
en: 0 Shakra, the great Asura, Namuchi of great power has been slain by you; so are Shambara and Bala, both of great prowess.

sa: बृहस्पतिसमं बुद्ध्या क्षमया पृथिवीससम्। समुद्रमिव गाम्भीर्ये हिमवन्तमिव स्थिरम्॥
en: In intelligence equal to Brihaspati, in power equal to the earth, in gravity equal to the sea, in calmness equal to the Himavat,

sa: पक्षिभिः पक्षिभोजनः। आत्मकार्यं कृतं मेने चर्यायाश्च कृतं फलम्॥
en: That eater of birds, having been thus honored by those feathery creatures, considered his object accomplished and the result of his devotions achieved.

sa: कृतवर्मा च हार्दिक्यो भोजान्धकुकुरैः सह॥ अक्षौहिण्यैव सेनाया दुर्योधनमुपागमत्।
en: Kritavarman, the son of Hridika in company with the Bhojas, the Andhak and the Kukuras, went to Duryodhana with an Akshauhini of troops.

sa: ततः समभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। सप्तरात्रं महाभीमं न चान्यतरयोर्जयः॥
en: There upon began the battle capable of making down erect and continued for a week. On neither side there was victory or defeat.

sa: उच्चैर्बद्धानि चीराणि लक्ष्मणेन भवेदयम्। अभिज्ञानकृतः पन्था विकाले गन्तुमिच्छता॥
en: On high are barks set up by Lakşmaņa. Having to pass by the way at unusual hours, (Laksmana) has marked it with signs.

sa: अथकृष्णोऽप्यसम्भ्रान्तः पार्थेन सह मारिष। प्राध्यापयत् पाञ्चजन्यं शङ्ख प्रवरमोजसा॥
en: Thereupon the undaunted Krishna also, O sire, with Pritha's son, blew with force that most excellent conch of his, known as the Panchajanya.

sa: स्मृत्वा प्रतिज्ञां पार्थस्य दारुकं प्रत्यभाषत।। अर्जुनेन प्रतिज्ञातमार्तेन हतबन्धुना॥
en: And remembering the vow Pritha's son had made, thus addressed Daruka-"Afflicted with sorrow for the death of his dear-loved son, Arjuna has vowed.

sa: ततः पावकसंकाशैमवज्रविभूषितैः। जघान शेषं तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः॥
en: Threat with shafts resembling fire, and decked with diamonds and with gold, (Rāma) possessed of energy destroyed the rest of his (Khara's) forces.

sa: तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताहमिहागता। अन्यच्च तस्मिन् सुमहदाश्चर्यं लक्षितं मया।॥
en: Beholding that greatest wonder, I was struck with astonishment and have come hither. Also another great wonder was marked by me in him.

sa: गर्जतोऽस्य सुसंरब्धं भ्रातुः शत्रोर्विशेषतः। मर्षयिष्यामि केनापि कारणेन वरानने॥
en: O you of exquisite loveliness, my brother, and specially my enemy, is roaring lowly and haughtily-and how shall I put up with it?

sa: तत्र पुष्येऽभिषिञ्चस्व मनस्त्वरयतीव माम्। श्वस्त्वाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि यौवराज्ये परंतप ॥
en: My heart urges me to install you during the Pusya conjunction, so Oh! afflicter of foes, I shall install you to-morrow as heir-apparent.

sa: तत्क्षणै तु महाघोरं वनं निहतराक्षसम्। बभूव निरयप्रख्यं मांसशोणितकर्दमम्॥
en: And at that time that fearful forest, with the Rākṣasas slaughtered, and with its clay mired with flesh and blood, resembled hell itself.

sa: तानापतत एवाजौ भीमसेनो महाबलः। प्रत्युद्ययौ महाराज गजः प्रतिगजानिव॥
en: Then the highly powerful Bhima beholding them make towards himself in battle, O monarch, rushed against them like an elephants encountering his compeers.

sa: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति। अजानता महिमानं तवेदं मया प्रमादात् प्रणयेन वाऽपि॥ यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु। एकोऽथवाऽप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं तत् क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्॥
en: O Krishna, O Yadava, O friend, O undecaying One, O Infinite one, I beg your pardon for whatever has been said carelessly by me, and whatever disrespect has been shown to you not knowing your greatness, and considering you friend from want of judgment or from love, either out of mirth or on occasions of play lying, sitting or at meals, while alone or in the presence of others.

sa: स्त्रियश्चपुरुषा मार्ग सर्वालङ्कारभूषिताः। निर्भयाः प्रतिपद्यन्ते यदि रक्षति भूमिपः॥
en: If the king observes the duty of protection, women adorned with ornaments may fearlessly walk about everywhere without male relatives to guard them.

sa: तस्य शब्देन महता समुद्भूतोदधिप्रभम्। बभ्राम तत्र तत्रैव देवसैन्यमचेतनम्॥
en: On hearing that noise, the celestial army was agitated like the great ocean-and it was stunned and it remained fixed in one place.

sa: तान्युपादाय विस्रब्यो भक्षयामास स द्विजः। तस्मिंश्च भक्षयत्येव शङ्खोऽप्याश्रममागतः॥
en: Getting them the Rishi Likhita began to eat them without feeling any pinch of conscience. While thus eating Shankha returned to his hermitage.

sa: चतुरस्र महाराज त्रयस्त्रिंशत् तु मण्डलम्॥ तत्र तिष्ठन्ति कौरव्य चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः। दिग्गजा भरतश्रेष्ठ वामनरावतादयः॥ सुप्रतीकस्तथा राजन् प्रभिन्नकरटामुखः!
en: It is like a star in shape having four corners. O king, it has thirty three Mandalas. ) descendant of Kuru, there live four great clephants adored by all, o best among the Bharata race, they are Vamana, Airavata, Supratika with rent temples and also another.

sa: ये नदीषु समुद्रेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च। वृक्षालेषु गोष्ठेषु कान्तारे गहनेषु च॥ चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चत्वरेषु तटेषु च। हस्त्यश्वरथशालासु जीर्णोद्यानालयेषु च॥ येषु पञ्चसु भूतेषु दिशासु विदिशासु च। चन्द्रार्कयोर्मध्यगता ये च चन्द्रार्करश्मिषु॥ रसातलगता ये च ये च तस्मै परं गताः। नमस्तेभ्यो नमस्तेभ्यो नमस्तेभ्योऽस्तुनित्यशः॥
en: I always salute those Rudra who live in rives, in oceans in hills and mountains, in mountain-caves in the roots of trees, in cowpens, in dreary forests, in the injunction of roads, in roads, in open squares, in banks, in elephant-sheds, in stables, in car-sheds, in deserted gardens and houses, in the five principal elements, and in the cardinal and subsidiary points. I salute then again and again who live in the space amidst the Sun and Moon, as also in rays of the Sun and the Moon and them who live in the nether regions, and them who have followed the path of Renunciation and other superior practices for the sake of the Supreme.

sa: ततः कुमुदखण्डाभो निर्मलं निर्मलोदयः। प्रजगाम नभश्चन्द्रो हंसो नीलमिवोदकम्॥
en: Thereupon the Moon, white as water-lily and of clear appearance proceeded far down the welkin like to a goose traversing the blue waters.

sa: स्तुत्वैवं स महादेवं विरराम प्रजापतिः। भगवानपि सुप्रीतः पुनर्दक्षमभाषत॥ परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते दक्ष स्तवनानेन सुव्रत। बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मत्समीपे भविष्यसि॥
en: Hearing these adorations, that Lord of all creatures, viz., Mahadeva, stopped. Indeed, highly pleased, the illustrious god addressed Daksha, saying,-0 Daksha of excellent vows, I have been pleased with these adorations of yours. You need not swell the chorus of my adoration any longer! You shall have my companionship.

sa: वसतो दण्डकारण्ये तस्याहममितौजसः। रक्षसापहृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना ॥
en: While that one, of unmitigated effulgence was thus living in the forest of Dandaka, I, his consort, was stolen by the vicious-souled Rākşasa—Rāvaņa.

sa: तेऽथ रोषसमाविष्टाः सुभृशं जातमन्यवः। आरेभिरे महत्कर्म तदा शक्रभयंकरम्॥
en: On this the Rishis became exceedingly angry and were filled with sorrow. They began a great act which was a terror to Indra.

sa: ववल्गुश्चात्र कासांचित् कुण्डलानि शुभार्चिषाम्। मुखमारुतसंकम्पैर्मन्दं मन्दं च योषिताम्॥
en: The ear-rings of some dames possessed of a pleasant sheen, stirred by the air that was breathing about their faces, were undulating gently.

sa: यस्य यज्ञैर्यथादिष्टैर्युक्तो धर्मस्य संचयः। शरीरक्लेशसम्भूतं स धर्म परिमार्गते॥
en: He who is worthy of acquiring religious merit by celebrating sacrifices according to the ordinance, is now following morality by afflicting his person.

sa: एवमेव महेष्वास प्रियवाक्यान्महीपते। अहिंसा दृश्यते गुर्वी ततश्च प्रियमिष्यते॥
en: And similarly, O lord of the earth, O mighty monarch, abstenance from malice is (sometimes) deemed superior to sweet speech and vice versa.

sa: मत्स्यानां विप्रकारांस्ते बहूनस्मानकीर्तयन्॥ तेषां भयाभिभूतानां तदस्माभिः प्रतिश्रुतम्। प्रथमं तैर्ग्रहीतव्यं मत्स्यानां गोधनं महत्। सप्तम्यामपराठे वै तथा तैस्तु समाहितम्॥
en: Various were the oppressions of the Matsya's described to us-and we promised them help, assailed with fear as they were. And the arrangement with them was that they should first, on the afternoon of the seventh lunar day, seize the great collection of the precious kine of the Matsya's.

sa: तमग्निमिव संशान्तमम्बुहीनमिवार्णवम्। गतप्रभमिवादित्यं स्वर्गस्थं प्रेक्ष्य भूमिपम्॥ कौसल्या बाष्पपूर्णाक्षी विविधं शोककर्शिता। उपगृह्य शिरो राज्ञः कैकेयी प्रत्यभाषत ॥
en: Seeing the king had ascended heaven, like to a fire that has cooled, or an ocean deprived of its waters, or the sun shorn of his splendour, Kausalyā afflicted with woe, taking on her lap the head of the king, with tears in her eyes, said.

sa: ततो मन्युपरीतात्मा जगाम यदुनन्दनः। तीर्थयात्रां हलधरः सरस्वत्यां महायशाः॥
en: Enraged at this, that illustrious son of Yadu's race, viz., the wielder of the plough, then started on a pilgrimage of the Sarasvati.

sa: राजर्षिविप्रदैत्यानां गन्धर्वाणां च योषितः। रक्षसां चाभवन् कन्यास्तस्य कामवशंगताः॥
en: Daughters of Rajarsis, of Vipras, of Daityas, of Gandharvas, and of Rākşasas, having come under the influence of desire, had become his wives.

sa: विदेहराजस्य सुता तथा चारुतपस्विनी। दुःखस्यानुचिता दुःखं वने पर्युद्विजिष्यति॥
en: The fair daughter of Videha's king unworthy of hardship, in ascetic guise is leading a life of trouble and terror in the woods.

sa: दण्डकानां महद् राज्यं ब्राह्मणेन विनाशितम्। तालजंघं महाक्षत्रमौर्वेणैकेन नाशितम्॥
en: The large kingdom of the Dandakas was destroyed by a Brahmana. The powerful Kshatriya Talajangha was destroyed by a single Brahmana, viz., Aurva.

sa: पुण्यैश्च नियताहारैः शोभितं परमर्षिभिः। तद्ब्रह्मभवनप्रख्यं ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम्॥ ब्रह्मविद्भिर्महाभागैाह्मणैरुपशोभितम्। तद् दृष्ट्वा राघवः श्रीमांस्तापसाश्रममण्डलम्॥ अभ्यगच्छन्महातेजा विज्यं कृत्वा महद् धनुः।
en: Beholding that collection of asylums belonging to the ascetics, resembling the regions of Brahmă, resonant with the voices of Vedic recitations; and grateful; with highly pious Brāhmaṇas versed in the Vedas, the exceedingly energetic and graceful Rāghava entered the same, having first unstrung his mighty bow.

sa: पृथिव्यां राजसिंहानां मुख्यस्य विदितात्मनः। स्नुषा दशरथस्याहं शत्रुसैन्यप्रणाशिनः॥ दुहिता जनकस्याहं वैदेहस्य महात्मनः। सीतेति नाम्ना चोक्ताहं भार्या रामस्य धीमतः॥
en: I am the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, knowing his own self, the foremost of the kings of the world and the slayer of the enemy's host, and the daughter of Janaka the high-souled king of Vaideha. My name is Sītā and I am the consort of the highly intelligent Rāma.

sa: पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त तस्मिन् वीरवरक्षये। पाण्डवाऽपि महाराज स्मरन्तो विविधान् बहून्॥
en: They rushed against the Pandavas in that battle destructive of many heroes. The Pandavas also, O monarch, remembering the diverse woes and hardships.

sa: न बभूव तदा कश्चिद्युयुत्सोरस्य संमुखे। सर्वानाविद्ध्य वित्रस्तांस्ततः शक्रोऽब्रवीत्सुरान्।।५
en: None could stand before him, well-versed in war-fare. Thereupon beholding the deities terrified and pierced with shafts, Indra, the king of gods, said.

sa: तं प्रविश्याश्रमं दृष्ट्वा भृगोर्भार्यामनिन्दिताम्। हृच्छयेन समाविष्टो विचेताः समपद्यत॥
en: He, having entered into the hermitage, saw the irreproachable wife of Bhrigu. Seeing her he was filled with lust and lost his reason.

sa: हस्तप्राप्तमहं मन्ये साम्प्रतं सव्यसाचिनम्। निर्जित्य दुर्घरं द्रोणं सपदानुगमाहवे॥
en: I think I am now within a hand's distance from Savyasachin. Having vanquished in are battle, the indomitable Drona together with his followers.

sa: तं चाप्यतिक्रमन्तस्ते ददृशुर्वालुकार्णवम्। अवैक्षन्त महाशैलं मेरुं शिखरिणां वरम्॥
en: Crossing the Himavat, they saw a vast desert of sand. They then saw the powerful mountain Meru. The foremost of all highpeaked mountains.

sa: ब्रह्मदत्तवरा ह्येते घोरास्त्रिपुरवासिनः॥ पीडयन्त्यधिकं लोकं यस्मात् ते वरदर्पिताः।
en: The denizens of the three cities, having obtained boons from Brahma and proud in consequence of those boons, are excessively oppressing the worlds.

sa: ये चैनमुपसर्पन्ति ये च दूरपथं गताः। अहमैरावतज्येष्ठभ्रातृभ्योऽकरवं नम:॥
en: I salute you all that have Airavata for their elder brother, whether you live near him or stay at a distance from him.

sa: रामोऽपि धनुरादाय रथमारुह्य सत्वरः। विसृजशरवर्षाणि व्यधमत् पार्थिवं बलम्॥
en: Rama also, taking up his bow and quickly getting on his car, discharged showers of arrows and punished the army of the king.

sa: कलत्रस्य बहुत्वाद्धि सम्पतत्सु ततस्ततः। प्रयत्नमकरोत् पार्थो जनस्य परिरक्षणे॥
en: The concourse was very large. The robbers attacked it, at different points. Arjuna tried his best to protect it, but could not succeed.

sa: वंशभोज्यमिदं राज्यमर्थितव्यं यथा तथा। येन केनाप्युपायेन वृद्धानामिति शासनम्॥
en: The sages have laid down their authority by saying, that the ancestral kingdom should be obtained under any circumstance or by any means.

sa: पक्षानिलहतश्चास्य प्राकम्पत स शैलराट्। मुमोच पुष्पवर्षं च समागलितपादपः॥
en: That king of the mountains trembled, having been struck with the storm, raised by Garuda's wings. The trees thereon dropped showers of flowers.

sa: अनीकमध्ये तिष्ठन्तं राजपुत्रं दुरासदम्। अब्रवीद् भरतश्रेष्ठः गुडाकेशं जनार्दनः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, then Janardana (Krishna) thus spoke to that invincible hero Gudakesha standing in the midst of his troops.

sa: तालमीत्रमथोत्प्लुत्य न्यपतत् स भृशातुरः॥ व्यनदद् भैरवं नादं धरण्यामल्पजीवितः।
en: Thereat bounding up high as a palmyra palm, that one whose saws had almost run out, uttered terrible sounds, lying on the earth.

sa: प्रकीर्णमूर्धजाः सर्वा विमुक्ताभरणस्रजः। उरांसि पाणिभिर्जन्त्यो व्यलपन् करुणं स्त्रियः॥
en: They were seen with disheveled hair and divested of ornaments and garlands Beating their breasts with their hands, the indulged in heart-rendering lamentations.

sa: हन्यादेतान्संपतन्ती शाखेत्यथ विचिन्त्य सः। नखैदूंढतरं वीरः संगृह्य गजकच्छपौ॥
en: If the bough fell down, the Rishis will be killed.” Reflecting thus, the mighty bird held more firmly the elephant and the tortoise.

sa: भिक्षुको विचरिष्येते शोचन्तौ पृथिवीमिमाम्। कुलघ्नमीदृशं पापं जनयित्वा कुपूरुषम्॥
en: Grieving, they will wander about as beggars on the earth, having begotten such a wicked and vicious man, the exterminator of his race.

sa: भवांश्च मध्यस्थतया नित्यमस्मानुपेक्षते। सोऽहं कुपथमारूढः पश्य दैवमिदं मम॥
en: Though you are always in our midst, yet always neglect us. Alas! what a wrong course have I taken! Behold my evil Destiny!”

sa: इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलः कौशिकः स तपोधनः। उत्तरां दिशमुद्दिश्य प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Having said this, that tiger-like ascetic, Kusika's son, along with other anchorets having asceticism for their wealth, set out in a northerly direction.

sa: महानसेषु सिद्धेषु संस्कृतेऽतीव भारत। आहार्यमाणे कृमयो व्यदृश्यन्त सहस्रशः॥
en: In cook-rooms, upon food that was clean and well-boiled, were soon, when it was served out for eating, innumerable worms of various kinds.

sa: निपयात रथोपस्ये मूर्छयाभिपरिप्लुतः। प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञा मारुतिः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
en: Squatted down on the terrace of his car, being overwhelmed with a swoon. Regaining his senses, the son of Maruta, overwhelmed with rage.

sa: वेदशास्राणि सर्वाणि धर्मोश्च मनुजेश्वर। वेदांश्च चतुरः सर्वान् निखिलेनानुबुद्ध्यसे॥
en: You know the subtile sciences connected with the Vedas, all the duties of religion, O king, and the whole of the four Vedas.

sa: आश्वमेधिकमासाद्य भोजनं सार्वकामिकम्। तथाऽऽश्रमनिवासे तु हविष्यं भोजयेद् द्विजान्॥
en: When the Ashvamedhika Parva is reached, agreeable food should be served and when the Ashramavasika is reached, Brahmanas should be served with Havishya.

sa: ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो देवा महोदरनिभोदराः। त्वया तु भगवन्सृष्टाः प्रजानाथ चतुर्विधाः॥ त्वया दत्तोऽयमस्माकमायुषः पवनः पतिः। सोऽस्मन्प्राणेश्वरो भूत्वा कस्मादेषोऽद्य सत्तम ॥ रुरोध दुःखं जनयनन्तःपुर इव स्त्रियः।
en: With their bellies swollen for the obstruction of the wind the celestials with folded hands said: "O lord of created beings, you have created four classes of beings and you have given us wind to preserve our lives. But we do not know, why the wind, the lord of our beings, is distressing us, by obstructing our movements like to females confined in an inner apartment.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच य एष रोषात् प्रतपन् बलस्थो यो नः सेनां सिह इवेक्षते च। येनाहृतास्त्रिशतं वाजिमेधाः॥
en: He who scorches us with his wrath, he who stays in the midst of his force, he who will attack our troops like a lion, he who has performed three hundred Ashvamedha sacrifices, that banner of the Kuru race, that Bhishma, is yonder.

sa: मार्कण्डेयोऽथ मौद्गल्यो वामदेवश्च काश्यपः। कात्यायनोऽथ जाबालिगौतमो नारदस्तथा॥ एते द्विजर्षभाः सर्वे आसनेषूपवेशिताः। महर्षीन्समनुप्राप्तानभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः॥ मन्त्रिणो नैगमाश्चैव यथार्हमनुकूलिताः। तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां दीप्ततेजसाम्॥ राघवः सर्वमाचष्टे द्विजोऽयमुपरोधति।
en: Markandeya, Maudgalya, Vamadeva, Kashyapa, Katyayana, Javali, Gautama, and Nārada, these eight leading Brāhmaṇas having takes their seats, Rāma with folded hands, saluted them. And he showed due civilities towards his minister, citizens, Rșis and all others. There upon all the highly effulgent Rșis being accommodated with seats Råma narrated duly before them the account of the Brāhmaṇa and said. This Brāhmaṇa is waiting at the Palace-gate.

sa: श्येन उवाच नोक्षाणं राजन् पार्थयेयं न चान्यदस्मान्मांसमधिकं वा कपोतात्। देवैर्दत्तः सोध्यं ममैष भक्षस्तन्मे ददस्व शकुनानामभावात्॥
en: The Hawk said : O king, I do not ask for a bull or any other meat or meat more than what is in that pigeon. He (the pigeon) is my food today ordained by the gods. Therefore give him up to me.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पृथयाप्येवमुक्तस्तु प्रणम्यैव वचोऽब्रवीत्। यथा हि रावणो लोके इन्द्रजिच्च महाबलः। वर्मवीर्यसमो लोके विशिष्टश्चाभवं नृषु॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus addressed by Kunti, he replied respectfully-Just as there are in this world Ravana and Meghanada who were very strong, so also I am gigantic and valorous among the men of this world; in fact I am greater than any.

sa: कामगाः कामचारिण्यः कामात् कामांश्च भुञ्जते॥ वाप्यः सरांसि सरितो विविधानि वनानि च। गृहाणि पर्वताश्चैव यावद्र्व्यं च किंचन॥ मनोज्ञं सर्वभूतेभ्यः सर्वतन्त्रं प्रदृश्यत। ईदृशाद् विपुलाल्लोकान्नास्ति लोकस्तथाविधः॥
en: Capable of going everywhere at will and actually going from place to place with ease, they enjoy the fruition of desire after desire as it arises in their minds. Lakes, tanks, rivers, forests of diverse kinds, mansions, hills and all kinds of delightful objects are to be seen there. There is no region of happiness that is superior to any of these of which I speak.

sa: एतामहिंसां यज्ञेषु ब्रूयास्त्वं सततं प्रभो। प्रीतास्ततो भविष्यामो वयं तु द्विजसत्तम॥ विसर्जिताः समाप्तौ च सत्रादस्माद् व्रजामहे।
en: You should always, O powerful one, commend such abstention from injury in all sacrifices. We shall then be highly pleased, O foremost of twice-born ones. After the completion of your sacrifice, when dismissed by you, we shall then, leaving this place, go away.

sa: निरिन्द्रिया ह्यशास्त्राश्च स्त्रियोऽनृतमिति श्रुतिः। शय्यासनमलंकारमन्नपानमनार्यताम्॥ दुर्वाग्भावं रतिं चैव ददौ स्त्रीभ्यः प्रजापतिः। न तासां रक्षणं शक्यं कर्तुं पुंसा कथंचन॥ अपि विश्वकृता तात कुतस्तु पुरुषैरिह।
en: The Shruti declares that women are gifted with the most powerful senses that they have no scriptures to follow, and that they are living lies. Beds, seats, ornaments, food and drink and the absence of all that is respectable and righteous, indulgence in disagreeable words, and love of sexual companionship these were bestowed by Brahman upon women. Men are quite unable to restrain them within limits.

sa: न वृत्तं मन्यते तस्य मन्यते न च पातकम्। तथा स्वकर्मनिर्वृत्तं न पुण्यं न च पापकम्॥
en: The conduct of the person who is devoted to Brahman is not considered either way. His sins are never considered as sins. So also the man who is devoted to the duties laid down for him, is considered as neither pious nor sinful.

sa: द्राविडाश्च कलिङ्गाश्च पुलिन्दाश्चाप्युशीनराः। कोलिसर्पा माहिषकास्तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः॥ वृषलत्वं परिगता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात्। श्रेयान् पराजयस्तेभ्यो न जयो जयतां वर॥
en: The Dravidas, the Kalingas, the Pulindas the Ushinaras, the Kolisarpas, the Mahishakas, and other Kshatriyas, have, on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among their midst, become degraded into Shudras. Defeat from them is preferable to victory, O foremost of victorious persons.

sa: नहुष उवाच करवाणि प्रियं किं ते तन्मे ब्रूहि द्विजोत्तम। सर्वं कर्तास्मि भगवान् यद्यपि स्यात् सुदुष्करम्॥
en: Nahusha said Tell, me, O best of twiceborn ones, what act shall we do that may be pleasing to you? However difficult that deed may be, there is nothing, O holy one, that I shall not be able to do at your command.

sa: उदाहतः सर्वथा ते गुणानां मयैकदेशः प्रसमीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या। शक्तिर्न मे काचिदिहास्ति वक्तुं गुणान् सर्वान् परिमातुं तथैव॥
en: Observing with the help of intelligence, I have mentioned to you only a small portion of the merits of Ganga. My power, however, is inadequate to speak of all the merits of the sacred river, or indeed, to measure her power and sanctity.

sa: यो मां प्रयतते हन्तुं धृत्या सत्यपराक्रमः। भावो भवामि तस्याहं स च मां नावबुध्यते॥ यो मां प्रयतते हन्तुं तपसा संशितव्रतः। ततस्तपसि तस्याथ पुनः प्रादुर्भवाम्यहम्॥ यो मां प्रयतते हन्तुं मोक्षमास्थाय पण्डितः। तस्य मोक्षरतिस्थस्य नृत्यामि च हसामि च। अवध्यः सर्वभूतानामहमेकः सनातनः॥
en: And if the man whose strength lies in truth, wish to overcome me by patience, I appear to him as is mind, and thus he does not perceive my existence, and if the man of austere religious practices, wish to destroy me by means of asceticism, I appear in the dress of asceticism in his mind, and thus he is prevented from knowing me, and the man of learning, who with the object of attaining salvation wish to destroy me, I frolic and laugh in the face of such a man intent on salvation. I am the everlasting one without an equal, whom no creature can kill or destroy.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच सा ब्रह्मदण्डकल्पेन तेन मूर्ध्नि हता तदा। कृत्या पपात मेदिन्यां भस्म सा च जगाह ह॥
en: Bhishma said Struck then, on the head, by the Sannyasin, with his triple stick which resembled the punishment inflicted by a Brahmana, the Rakshasi who had originated from the incantations of king Vrishadarbhi dropped down on the Earth and becoine reduced to ashes.

sa: नोत्सहत्यमृतो मोक्तुं युद्धे त्वामिति मैथिलि। सामात्यस्य नृशंसस्य निश्चयो ह्येष वर्तते॥ तदेषां सुस्थिरा बुद्धिर्मृत्युलोभादुपस्थिता। भयान शक्तस्त्वां मोक्तुमनिरस्तः स संयुगे॥ राक्षसानां च सर्वेषामात्मनश्च वधेन हि।
en: O Maithili, without renouncing his life in battle, he does not intend to liberate you. Even this is the determination which that cruel one has arrived at along with his advisers. This intent is in consequence of their coveting surcease. He can not yield you up from sheer fear; not is he backward in battle, or shirk his own destruction or that of all the Rākşasas.

sa: मलपङ्कधरां दीनां मण्डनार्हाममण्डिताम्। प्रभां नक्षत्रराजस्य कालमेघैरिवावृताम्॥ तस्य संदिदिहे बुद्धिस्तथा सीतां निरीक्ष्य च। आम्नायानामयोगेन विद्यां प्रशिथिलामिव॥
en: Worthy of Wearing ornaments but now without any, poorly, crusted with execrations, she appeared like the rays of the stars enveloped by dark-blue clouds. And beholding Sītã in that pitiable plight like to learning for want of practice, (Hanumān) was Puzzled with doubts.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठ पर्वताकारदर्शनम्। क्रममाणमिवाकाशं पुरा नारायणं यथा॥ सतोयाम्बुदसंकाशं काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम्। दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रदुद्राव वानराणां महाचमूः॥
en: Seeing that foremost of Rākşasas looking like a mountain; filling all the heavens as formerly Nārāyaṇa had done; resembling clouds charged with rain; and adorned with golden Angadas, the mighty army of monkeys began to run away at the top of its speed.

sa: अनाधृष्यतमं देवमपि देवर्षिराक्षसैः। अनासाद्यैव पतितो भास्करोदयने गिरौ॥ पतितस्य कपेरस्य हनुरेका शिलातले। किंचिद्भिना दृढहनुर्हनूमानेष तेन वै॥
en: And, not getting that god, incapable of being subdued by the deities, saints and Rākṣasas, he dropped down on the Ascending-hill. And thereat a jaw of that strong jawed one was little fractured on the rock, and he is called Hanuman in consequence.

sa: एते तु रौद्रा बहवो महारथा यशस्विनः शूरतमाः कृतास्त्राः। ये पाण्डवानां समरे सहाया जितक्लमा रोषविषं वमन्ति॥
en: These mighty car-warrior, who have sided with the Pandavas in this battle, innumerable, formidable, all foremost horses, endued with renown and accomplished in the use of weapons; they are indefatigable and are seem to vomit forth the venom of their wrath in battle.

sa: ततो गजगतो राजा भगदत्तः प्रतापवान्। अर्जुनं शरवर्षेण वारयामास संयुगे॥ अर्जुनस्तु ततो नागमायान्तं रजतोपमैः। विमलैरायसैस्तीक्ष्णैरविध्यत महारणे॥
en: The highly puissant king Bhagadatta confronted Arjuna, and held the latter in check with a thick shower of arrows. Thereupon Arjuna pierced the elephant of Bhagadatta rushing towards himself in battle, with many keep pointed and iron made arrows, all bright as silver.

sa: स कश्यपस्य वचनात् प्रोत्सार्य सरितां पतिम्। इषुपाते युधां श्रेष्ठः कुर्वन् ब्राह्मणशासनम्॥ अध्यावसद् गिरिश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रं पर्वतोत्तमम्।
en: At the words of Kasyapa, that best of warriors obedient to the Brahmanas' command, caused, by the fall of his arrows, the very occan to roll back; then going to the foremost of mountains, namely, the Mahendra mountain, he continued to live there.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमुखाः सर्वे समुद्विविजिरे मुहुः। एकादशैताः श्रीजुष्टा वाहिन्यस्तव पार्थिव॥ पाण्डवानां तथा सप्त महापुरुषपालिताः। उन्मत्तमकरावर्ती महाग्राहसमाकुलौ॥ युगान्ते समवेतौ द्वौ दृश्यते सागराविव। नैव नस्तादृशो राजन् दृष्टपूर्वो न च श्रुतः। अनीकानां समेतानां कौरवाणां तथाविधः॥
en: All the warriors headed by Dhrishtadyumna trembled (when they saw him) O kings; these are the eleven great divisions of your army. The seven divisions of the Pandava army were also protected by foremost of men. The two armies facing each other looked like two mighty oceans at the end of Yuga, oceans agitated by fearful by fearful Makaras Makaras and huge crocodiles. O king, we never be fore saw or heard of two such armies meeting each other as these two armies of the Kurus.

sa: ततो भीष्मः शान्तनवो नित्यं मण्डलकार्मुकः। मुमोच बाणान् दीप्ताचानहीनाशीविषानिव॥ शरैरेकायनीकुर्वन् दिशः सर्वा यतव्रतः। जघान पाण्डवरथानादिश्यादिश्य भारत।॥
en: Then the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, with his bow always drawn to a circle, poured a continuous shower of arrows that resembled so many poisonous snakes. Creating continuous lines of arrows in all directions, that vowobserving hero killed innumerable car-warriors of the Pandava's.

sa: शक्त्यानदानं सततं तितिक्षा धर्मनित्यता॥ यथार्ह प्रति पूजा च सर्वभूतेषु वै सदा। त्यागान्नान्यत्र मर्त्यानां गुणास्तिष्ठन्ति पूरुषे॥
en: Giving away food incessantly to the best of one's power, patience and firm belief in virtue, necessary regard for all creatures always, these virtues are present only in that person, who has wholly abandoned the world (the worldly pleasures); but in none else.

sa: गार्ग्य उवाच आतिथ्यं सततं कुर्याद् दीपं दद्यात् प्रतिश्रये। वर्जयानो दिवा स्वापं न च मांसानि भक्षयेत्॥
en: Gargya said One should always do the duties of hospitality to his guests. One should give lamps in the hall or shed where sacrifices are celebrated. One should avoid sleep during the day, and abstain from all sorts of flesh or food. never

sa: आत्मापि चायं न मम सर्वा वा पृथिवी मम। यथा मम तथाऽन्येषामिति चिन्त्य न मे व्यथा।।
en: I do not consider even my own self to be mine. On the other hand, I consider the whole world to be mine. I again consider all this as much mine as it belongs to others. Grief cannot attack me for this thought.

sa: प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय गणान् क्रुद्धो वृकोदरः। अमीषाहाञ्छूरसेनान् क्षत्रियान् युद्धदुर्मदान्॥ निकृत्य पृथिवीं चक्रे भीमः शोणितकर्दमाम्। यौधेयानद्रिजान् राजन् मद्रकान्मालवानपि॥
en: Were wrathfully sent by Yudhishthira to the region of Death. Cutting off (into pieces) the Abhisahas, the Surasenas and (other) Kshatriyas invincible in battle Bhima made the earth muddy with blood. (And) O king the Yaudheyas, the mountaineers, the Madrakas and the Malavas.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच नास्मिन्कुले जातु बभूव राजा यो न प्रजानां प्रियकृत्प्रियश्च। विशेषतः प्रेक्ष्य पितामहानां वृत्तं महद्वृत्तपरायणानाम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : None was born in our dynasty who did not look after the good of his subjects and who was not beloved by them. See specially the conduct of my grandfathers (five Pandava brothers) who were ever engaged in great deeds.

sa: जनमेजयश्च पाञ्चाल्यः कर्णं विव्याध सायकैः॥ वाराहाकर्णनाराचैर्नालीकैर्निशितैः शरैः। वत्सदन्तैर्विपाठैश्च क्षुरप्रैश्चटकामुखैः॥ नानाप्रहरणैश्चोत्रै रथहस्तश्वसादिभिः। सर्वतोऽभ्यद्रवत् कर्णं परिवार्य जिघांसया॥
en: The Panchala prince Janamejaya then struck Karna with many arrows. Encircling Karna with a view to kill him they all rushed upon him with various arrows, such as boareared, Narachas, Nalika, Nishat, calf-toothed, Vipatha, razor shaped, with diverse other weapons chariots horses, elephants.

sa: तिर्यग्योनिगतानां च शतानि सरयूजलम्॥ संप्राप्य त्रिदिवं जग्मुः प्रभासुरवपूंषि तु। दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन्।॥
en: And having obtained the waters of Sarayū, hundreds of those that were born in the race of birds attained to the land of immortals obtaining the respective celestial forms (they had before). And in those celestial forms, they looked effulgent like the deities.

sa: परस्परं वर्तमानान् दुपदस्यात्मजां प्रति। यो नोऽनुप्रविशेन्मोहात् स वै द्वादशवार्षिकम्॥ वने चरेद् ब्रह्मचर्यमिति वः समयः कृतः।
en: This was the rule which all of you made amongst you for having Draupadi as you common wife, that he who would by ignorance enter the room in which one of you would be with her, he must adopt Brahmacharya for twelve years.

sa: विविक्तान्युपलक्ष्याथ तानि तीर्थानि पाण्डवः। दृष्ट्वा च वय॑मानानि मुनिभिर्धर्मबुद्धिभिः॥ तपस्विनस्ततोऽपृच्छत् प्राञ्जलिः कुरुनन्दनः। तीर्थानीमानि वय॑न्ते किमर्थं ब्रह्मवादिभिः॥
en: The Pandava, the descendant of Kuru (Arjuna), finding them uninhabited and ascertaining that they were shunned by the ascetics, asked with joined hands those pious men that lived near them, “Why these Tirthas are shunned by the Brahmavadis (the utterers of the Vedas).”

sa: तमब्रवीद् देवराजो ममेदं त्वं विद्धि विद्वन् भुवनं वशे स्थितम्। ईशोऽहमस्मीति समन्युरब्रवीद् दृष्ट्वा तमक्षैः सुभृशं प्रमत्तम्॥
en: The king of the celestials thus spoke to him, “O intelligent youth, know this universe to be under my sway." Seeing that the person take no notice of what he had said, he (Indra) again said, “I am the lord of the universe."

sa: अधश्चक्रस्य चैवात्र दीप्तानलसमद्युती। विद्युज्जिह्वौ महावीर्यो दीप्तास्यौ दीप्तलोचनौ॥ चक्षुर्विषौ महाघोरी नित्यं क्रुद्धौ तरस्विनी। रथार्थमेवामृतस्य ददर्श भुजगोत्तमौ॥
en: He beheld, within the line of the wheel, stationed there to guard the Soma, two great snakes, as blazing as the blazing fire, having tongues like lightning; power incomparable, face and eyes emitting fire, poisonous terrible, always in anger and always in activity.

sa: मयूरनादिता रम्याः प्रांशवो बहुकन्दराः। दृश्यन्ते गिरयः सौम्य फुल्लैस्तरुभिरावृताः॥ सौवर्णं राजतैस्तारैर्देशे देशे तथा शुभैः। गवाक्षिता इवाभान्ति गजाः परमभक्तिभिः॥ सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च खजूरैः पनसैर्दुमैः। नीवारैस्तिनिशैश्चैव पुन्नागैश्चौपशोभिताः॥ चूतैरशोकैस्तिलकैः केतकैरपि चम्पकैः। पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैस्तैस्तैस्तरुभिरावृताः॥ स्यन्दनैश्चन्दनैपैः पनसैलकुचैरपि। धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः॥
en: And resounding with the cries of peacocks; charming; elevated; containing full many a cave; do you, O amiable one, behold these hills, covered with trees in full flower; and they are shining like elephants painted with diverse colours by persons with the utmost care; adorned with Salas, palmyras, Tamālas, dates, Panasas, Nīvāras, Tinišas, and Punnāgas. And covered with mangoes, Asokas, Tilakas, Ketakas, and Campakas, and trees entwined by flowers, herbs and plants; and containing Syandanas, sandals, Nīpas, Paņāsas, Lakucas, Dhavas, Ašvakarņas, Khadiras, Samls, Kinsukas and Patalas.

sa: तैश्चाहमुक्ता धर्मज्ञैर्महाभागैर्महर्षिभिः। आगमिष्यति ते रामः सुपुण्यमिममाश्रमम्॥ स ते प्रतिग्रहीतव्यः सौमित्रिसहितोऽतिथिः। तं च दृष्ट्वा वरांल्लोकानक्षयांस्त्वं गमिष्यसि॥
en: Those great ascetics, cognizant of virtue, said to me, Rāma shall come to your holy asylum. Do you receive with great reverence that guest together with Laksmana. On beholding him, you shall attain to that best land of the celestials whence none return.

sa: मृगपक्षिभिरासीनो मुनिभिश्च समन्ततः। राममागतमभ्यर्च्य स्वागतेनागतं मुनिः॥ प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम_मुपविष्टं स राघवम्। भरद्वाजोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं धर्मयुक्तमिदं तदा॥
en: Then paying homage to Rāma he proceeded by short stages, and asking him, Has your journey been a pleasant one?, the ascetic sat down. And when Rāghava had sat down after receiving the homage, Bharadvāja spoke to him these words fraught with virtue.

sa: अभिगच्छामहे सर्वे शुचयः पुण्यमाश्रमम्। इह वासः परोऽस्माकं सुखं वत्स्यामहे निशाम्॥ स्नाताश्च कृतजप्याश्च हुतहव्या नरोत्तम ।
en: Let us then, having purified ourselves, enter the holy hermitage! It is highly desirable for us to sojourn here, here will we happily spend the night, having bathed, and recited the mantras, and offered oblations to the sacrificial fire, O best of men.

sa: श्रुत्वा प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा मुनिं तमनुमान्य च ॥ पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षं पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम्। ततः सा गृहमागम्य पत्नी पुत्रमजायत ॥
en: Hearing this, that noble lady having gone round him and paid in respect to the ascetic went to her home and gave birth to a son furnished with eyes resembling lotus petals, and of sheen like that of the inside of a lotus.

sa: रौक्मं वरं हस्तिगजाश्वयुक्तं रथं प्रदित्सुर्यः परेभ्यस्त्वदर्थे। सदा रणे स्पर्धते यः स पापः कचित्त्वया निहतस्तात युद्धे॥
en: Have you, O brother, really slain in battle the vicious scoundrel who was ever ready to challenge you and to give away to others a superb golden chariot along with bulls, steeds and elephants provided they could give him some clue to you?

sa: अथ तव रथमुख्यास्तान् प्रतीयुस्त्वरन्तः कृपहदिकसुतौ च द्रौणिदुर्योधन च। शकुनिसुतवृकौ च क्राथदेवावृधौ च द्विरदजलदघोषैः स्यन्दनैः कार्मुकैश्च॥
en: Then your leading car-warriors, viz. Hridaka's son, Kripa, Drona's son, Shakuni's son, Vrika, Krathadeva and Devavridha immediately advanced against them with their bows on cars, the wheels of which were rattling loudly like the roars of elephants or the boom of the clouds.

sa: तान् प्रत्यविध्यद् राधेयः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः। सात्यकेस्तु धनुश्छित्त्वा ध्वजं च भरतर्षभ॥ तं तथा नवर्भिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे।
en: And the son of Radha assailed them in return, each with five arrows and rending in twain, O best of the line of Bharata, the bow and standard of Satyaki, sped nine arrows against him, hitting him in the centre of his chest.

sa: लोकप्रवीरा येऽस्माकं देवकल्पा महारथः॥ नीतिमन्तस्तथा युक्ता दक्षा रक्ताक्ष ते हताः। न त्वेव कार्यं नैराश्यमस्माभिर्विजयं प्रति॥
en: Those foremost of men, the mighty carwarriors, on our side, who had been like the celestials and who were acquainted with the principles of government were all slain in battle. In spite of all these, there should be no disappointment as regards victory.

sa: कर्तास्मि मिषतां वोऽद्य ततो द्रक्ष्यथ मे बलम्। तेषामन्यतमेनाहं पतिष्यामि विहायसम्॥ प्रादिशध्वं यथान्यायं केन हंसाः पताम्यहम्।
en: These various motions I shall display before you. You will see my strength. With one of these diverse kinds of motions I shall immediately soar into the sky. Tell me, O swans, by which of these motion shall I course through the sky.

sa: चण्डवातोद्भुतान् मेघान् निघ्नन् रश्मिमुचो यथा॥ ततो राजन् महानासीत् संग्रामो भूरिवर्धनः। तावकानां परेषां च समेतानां युयुत्सया॥
en: And then destroyed them all like the possessor of rays destroying the clouds driven to and fro by a terrific hurricane. Then there took place, O king, a terrific battle causing great havoc between you and your enemy's assembled troops eager for fight.

sa: तत्रातुष्यन्त योधाश्च सिद्धाश्चापि दिवि स्थिताः॥ सुतसोमस्य तत् कर्म दृष्ट्वा श्रद्धेयमद्भुतम्। रथस्यं शकुनि यस्तु पदाति: समयोधयत्॥
en: There (in the field of battle) the warriors, as well as the Siddhas resting in the firmament, became highly gratificd to witness that extraordinary and incredible deed of Sutasoma. For he (Sutasoma) was fighting on foot with Shakuni, who rested upon his car.

sa: आप्तो दूतः संजय सुप्रियोऽसि कल्याणवाक् शीलवांस्तृप्तिमांश्च। न मुह्येस्त्वं संजय जातु मत्या न च क्रुद्ध्येरुच्यमानो दुरुक्तैः॥
en: As an enjoy sent (by them) O Sanjaya, you have made yourself dear to us and you are of peaceful speech, well behaved and satisfy every body. You are not ill disposed towards us and through spoken to harshly you are never angry.

sa: इदं च ब्रूया मा वृणीष्वेति लोके युद्धेऽद्वितीयं सचिवं रथस्थम्। शिनेर्नप्तारं प्रवृणीम सात्यकि महाबलं वीतभयं कृतास्त्रम्॥
en: Tell this also (to Duryodhana); Do not desire (the kingdom), we have chosen Satyaki, the guard of Shini for our leader; he is unequaled in battle in this world, a car-warrior of dauntless and powerful might and skilled in the use of weapons,

sa: अपानं गिरति प्राणः प्राणं गिरति चन्द्रमाः। आदित्यो गिरते चन्द्रमादित्यं गिरते परः। योगिनस्तं प्रपश्यन्ति भगवन्तं सनातनम्॥
en: The vital air called Apana is lost in the air called Prana which again is lost in the mind. The last again is lost in the intellect which again is lost in the supreme being. The ascetics perceive that Lord who is Eternal.

sa: उत्थानवीर्यः सुखमेधमानो दुर्योधनः सुकृतं मन्यते तत्। तेषां भागं यच्च मन्येत बाल: शक्यं हर्तुं जीवतां पाण्डवानाम्॥
en: Duryodhana who is strong in the beginning only and who is accustomed to every sort of indulgence thinks that he does well (increasing their energy). The boy thinks too that he is capable of robbing the living son of Pandu, of their share.

sa: कालो वा कारणं राज्ञो राजा वा कालकारणम्। इति ते संशयो मा भूद् राजा कालस्य कारणम्॥
en: Oking, do not linger in doubt as to whether the age that nature of the king or whether it is the king that rules that is the cause of the prevalence of a particular period. The king is the cause of the age.

sa: धर्मं पुरस्कृत्य तदा सर्वलोकाधिपोऽभवत्। सुदुर्लभं वरं लब्ध्वा प्राप्य राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे॥ धर्मात्मा सततं भूत्वा कामात्मा समपद्यत।
en: And placing virtue above everything else became the protector of the worlds. Being granted a rare boon and obtaining the kingdom in heaven, he gave himself up to gratifying every wish of his, though before this he had ever been a virtuous being.

sa: बलं कस्माद् वर्धयित्वा परस्य निजान् कस्मात् कर्शयित्वा सहायान्। निरुष्य कस्माद् वर्षपूगान् वनेषु युयुत्ससे पाण्डव हीनकालम्॥
en: Why after having increased the strength of your enemy and after weakening your own friends and after having lived in exile in the forest for a series of years, are you now desirous of fighting, O son of Pandu, after the proper time.

sa: अपश्यत् कृतमाकाशमनाकाशं जनार्दनैः। तदद्भुततमं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रो निरायुधः॥ अब्रवीदतिसंतप्तः कृपवाक्यमनुस्मरन्। ब्रुवतामप्रियं पथ्यं सुहृदां न शृणोति यः॥
en: Seeing that wonderful spectacle Drona's son, divested of weapons, recollected the words of Kripa, and burning with grief, said,-"He who hears not the beneficial words of friends, repents being overwhelmed with calamity, as does my foolish self for having disregarded by two well-wishers.

sa: इदं हि सद्भिः कथितं विधिज्ञैः पुरा महेन्द्रप्रतिमप्रभाव। मयापि चोक्तं तव शास्त्रदृष्ट्या यथैव बुद्ध्वा प्रचरस्व राजन्॥
en: O you powerful like Indra himself, this has been declared by ancient sages conversant with the scriptural injunctions! I, also, having my eyes on the scriptures, have said the same to you. Using your intelligence, do you act in this world, O king.'

sa: तेषां न तिर्यग्गमनं हि दृष्टं नार्वाग्गति पाप:कृताधिवासः। न वा प्रधाना अपि ते द्विजातयो ये ज्ञानमेतन्नृपतेऽनुरक्ताः॥
en: Those twice-born ones who are given to the acquisition of that knowledge which is recommended in the Sankhya system, even if they fail to acquire eminence, are never seen to fall among intermediate creatures, or to sink into the state of sinful men.

sa: समूह्यमाना बहुधा येन नीताः पृथग् घनाः। वर्षमोक्षकृतारम्भास्ते भवन्ति घनाघनाः॥ संहता येन चाविद्धा भवन्ति नदतां नदाः। रक्षणार्थाय सम्भूता मेघत्वमुपयान्ति च॥ योऽसौ वहति भूतानां विमानानि विहायसा। चतुर्थः संवहो नाम वायुः स गिरिमर्दनः॥
en: That wind which supports the clouds and divides them into various parts which melts them for pouring rain and once more solidifies them, which is perceived as the sound of roaring clouds, which exists for the preservation of the world by itself assuming the form of the clouds, which carries the cars of all celestials along the sky, is known by the name of Samvaha. The fourth in the number, it is gifted with great strength so that it is capable of rending the very mountains.

sa: वैदेह कं शूद्रमुदाहरन्ति द्विजा महाराज श्रुतोपपन्नाः। अहं हि पश्यामि नरेन्द्र देवं विश्वस्य विष्णु जगतः प्रधानम्॥
en: O king of the Videhas, Brahmanas learned in the Vedas, O king, regard a (virtutous) Shudra as equal to Brahman himself. I, however, O king, regard such a Shudra as the effulgent Vishnu of the universe, the foremost one in all the worlds.

sa: श्रद्धा च गुरुशुश्रूषा यमयोः परुषग्ययोः। अजातशत्रो भद्रं ते खाण्डवप्रस्थमाविश। भ्रातृभिस्तेऽस्तु सौभ्रानं धर्मे ते धीयतां मनः॥
en: And in those foremost of men, the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva), are pure reverence and service to superiors. O Ajatasatru, be blessed. Return to Khandavaprastha. Let there be brotherly love between you and your cousins. Let your mind be always fixed in virtue.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यो नो नेता युधि नः प्रणेता यथा वज्री दानवशत्रुरेकः। तिर्यक्प्रेक्षी संनतभूर्महात्मा सिंहस्कन्धो यश्च सदात्यमर्षी॥ बलेन तुल्यो यस्य पुमान् न विद्यते गदाभृतामय इहारिमर्दनः। अनर्हता राजपुत्रेण तेन दीव्याम्यहं भीमसेनेन राजन्॥
en: Yudhisthira said Though he does not deserve to be made a stake, I shall now play with staking Bhimasena, the prince who is our leader, who is foremost in fight like the wielder of thunder (Indra), the enerny of the Danavas, who is the illustrious hero with lion-like neck, arched eye-brows and expansive eyes, who is incapable of putting up with an insult, who is matchless in prowess in all the world, who is the foremost of all wielders of clubs and who grinds all foes.

sa: योऽयं परेषां पृतनां समृद्धां निरायुधो दीर्घभुजो निहन्यात्। श्रुत्वैव शब्दं हि वृकोदरस्य मुञ्चन्ति सैन्यानि शकृत् समूत्रम्॥
en: This Vrikodara (Bhima) here is able to destroy with the strength of his powerful arms only and without the help of any weapons a great array of hostile troops. Hearing his warcry the soldiers on a field of battle utterly lose their heart.

sa: राजपुत्र्युवाच वरं वृणे भगवंस्त्वेवमेष विमुच्यतां किल्बिषादद्य भर्ता। शिवेन चाध्याहि सपुत्रबान्धवं वरो वृतो ह्येष मया द्विजावय॥
en: The Queen said: O exalted one, this is the boon I ask, that my husband may now be freed from his sin and that you may think well of his son and kinsmen. O foremost of Brahmanas, this is the boon I ask.

sa: बन्धुवाच व्याघ्र शयानं प्रति मा प्रबोधय आशीविषं सृक्किणी लेलिहानम्। पदाहतस्येह शिरोऽभिहत्य नादष्टो वै मोक्ष्यसे तन्निबोध॥
en: Do not awaken a sleeping tiger. Know that you will not escape biting when you will trample on the head of a poisonous snake, which is licking the corner of its mouth with its tongue and which has been hurt by your foot.

sa: तत्र चिह्न महद् राजन्नद्यापि सुमहद् भृशम्॥ कपिलायाः सवत्सायाश्चरन्त्याः पर्वते कृतम्। सवत्सायाः पदानि स्म दृश्यन्तेऽद्यापि भारत॥
en: O king, there is still to be seen a greatly wonderful mark. The Kapilas with their calves used to roam over that mountain. O descendant of Bharata, the hoof-marks of Kapilas with their calves are to be seen there even up to date.

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्ग उवाच इहागतो जटिलो ब्रह्मचारी न वै ह्रस्वो नातिदीर्घो मनस्वी। सुवर्णवर्ण: कमलायताक्षः स्वतः सुराणामिव शोभमानः॥
en: Rishyashringa said : Here came a Brahmachari with masses of hair on his head. That intelligent one was neither short nor tall. His complexion was like gold; his expansive eyes were like the lotus. He was as blazing and beautiful as a celestials.

sa: ददर्श च महाभागां तपसा द्योतितप्रभाम्। लोकैरपि समागम्य दुर्निरीक्ष्यां सुरासुरैः॥ प्रयत्नानिर्मितां धात्रा दिव्यां मायामयीमिव। धूमेनाभिपरीताङ्गी दीप्तामग्निशिखामिव॥ सतुषारावृतां साभ्रां पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव। मध्येऽम्भसो दुराधर्षां दीप्तां सूर्यप्रभामिव ॥
en: They beheld that magnificent dame flaming in ascetic energy; and incapable of being gazed at too near even by the celestials and the Asuras; as if created by the Deity to be the divinely charming Woman; like a flame hid in smoke; or the brightness of the full moon clouded and dimmed in mist; or the solar splendour incapable of being beheld of account of clouds.

sa: क्षात्रेण धर्मेण पराक्रमेण जित्वा महीं मन्त्रविद्ध्यः प्रदाय। नाकस्य पृष्ठेऽसि नरेन्द्र गन्ता न शोचितव्यं भवताद्य पार्थ॥
en: Having, while observing Kshatriya duties, subjugated the world by the help of your prowess, and having made presents unto persons conversant with the Vedas, you can, O king, go to regions higher than heaven itself. You should not, O Partha, indulge in grief.'

sa: गृहणीष्व पिठरं तानं मया दत्त नराधिप। यावद् वय॑ति पाञ्चाली पात्रेणानेन सुव्रत॥ फलमूलामिषं शाकं संस्कृतं यन्महानसे। चतुर्विधं तदन्नाद्यमक्षय्यं ते भविष्यति॥ इतश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे भूयो राज्यमवाप्स्यसि।
en: O king, accept this copper vessel that I present you. O man of excellent vows, so long the Panchala excellent vows, so long the Panchala Princess (Draupadi) will hold this vessel without partaking of it contents-fruits, roots, meat and vegetables, cooked in your kitchen-the four kinds of food, shall from this day be (there) inexhaustible. You shall regain your kingdom on the fourteenth year from this.

sa: भस्त्रा माता पितुः पुत्रो येन जातः स एव सः॥ भरस्व पुत्रं दुष्यन्त मावमंस्थाः शकुन्तलाम्। रेतोधाः पुत्र उन्नयति नरदेव यमक्षयात्॥ त्वं चास्य धाता गर्भस्य सत्यमाह शकुन्तला। जाया जनयते पुत्रमात्मनोऽङ्गं द्विधा कृतम्॥
en: (It said), “O Dushyanta, the mother is but a sheath of flesh (within which the son dwells). The son, sprung from the father, is the father himself. Therefore, cherish your son and do not insult Shakuntala. O best of men, the son begotten by one's own self, rescues him from the abode of Yama. You are the father of this son. Shakuntala has spoken the truth. The husband divides his body in two parts and is born in the womb of his wife as the son.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत् कर्म भीमस्य समीक्ष्य कृष्ण: कुन्तीसुतौ तौ परिशरूमानः। निवारयामास महीपतींस्तान् धर्मेण लब्धेत्यनुनीय सर्वान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Seeing that feat of Bhima, Krishna believed them both to be the sons of Kunti. Gently addressing the assemble monarch by saying, “ This maiden has been greatly won (by the Brahmanas)” he induced them to desist from the fight.

sa: दृष्ट्वा कृशं विवर्णं च राजानमतथोचितम्। उपवासपरिश्रान्तं त्वगस्थिपरिवारणम्॥ धर्मपुत्रः स्वपितरं परिष्वज्य महाप्रभुम्। शोकजं बाष्पमुत्सृज्य पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing his royal father of great splendour, emaciated and palc, reduced to unworthy of him worn out with fasts, and loO king like skeleton covered with skin, Dharma's son Yudhishthira shed tears of grief and once more said these words.

sa: ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः पार्थमथाब्रवीत्। संक्रुद्धमिव नर्दन्तं हिरण्यकशिपुर्हरिम्॥
en: Like the Daitya king Hiranyakasipu addressing the roaring and enraged Hari, the son of the king of the Panchalas addressed

sa: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हपृक्षप्रवरैर्युतः। यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीञ्छोकं व्यपनयिष्यति॥
en: At once shall Käkutstha come, accompanied by the foremost of monkeys, who, conquering (Ravana) in conflict, shall remove your grief.

sa: प्रीतियुक्तस्तु सर्वेषां ददौ तेषां महात्मनाम्। तदेतद् देवदेवस्य धनूरत्नं महात्मनः॥ न्यासभूतं तदा न्यस्तमस्माकं पूर्वजे विभौ।
en: And well-pleased with them, he conferred this upon those high-souled ones. And even this is that jewel of a bow belonging to the high-souled god of gods, and which was ultimately, O lord, consigned as a trust to our ancestor.

sa: विक्षिपन् विविधाः शाखा नगानां कुसुमोत्कटाः। मारुतश्चलितस्थानैः षट्पदैरनुगीयते॥
en: The black bees, driven off and singing, pursue the wind, moving the many kinds of flowery branches of the trees.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा धृतराष्ट्रो युधिष्ठिरम्। अनुज्ञातस्त्वया पुत्र भुजीयामिति कामये॥
en: Gifted with great energy, Dhritarashtra then said to Yudhishthira, “I wish, O son, to take some food, with your permission.

sa: तमेवं कृतसंकल्पं जाम्बवान् हरिसत्तमः। उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित्॥
en: Thereupon Jāmbavāna, the foremost of the monkeys, greatly delighted spoke to Angada, who was thus resolved, the following pregnant words.

sa: भारद्वाजो रणे विद्धो युयुधानेन सत्वरम्। सात्यकि बहुभिर्बाणैर्यतमानमविध्यत॥
en: Pierced quickly by Yuyudhana in battle, the son of Bharadvaja, pierced Satyaki who had been fighting vigorously, with countless shafts.

sa: मूर्ध्नि चैनमुपाघ्राय सस्नेहं परिषस्वजे। सभाज्यमानो विप्रैश्च स्तूयमानश्च वन्दिभिः। स मुदं परमां लेभे पुत्रसंस्पर्शजां नृपः॥
