en: He smelt his son's head; he embraced him with affection. The Brahmanas uttered blessings on him and the bards began to applaud him. The king then enjoyed the great pleasure that one feels at the touch of one's own son.

sa: इत्युक्तानीन्द्रियाण्येतान्येकादश यथाक्रमम्। मन्यन्ते कृतमित्येवं विदित्वा तानि पण्डिताः॥
en: Thus have been enumerated the eleven organs in due order. Learned man, having understood these, think they have done everything.

sa: रथी रथिनमासाद्य प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्। तथेतरान् समासाद्य नरनागाश्वसादिनः॥
en: Car-warriors meeting car-warriors dispatched them to the abode of Death; so also others, men, horse-soldiers, elephant riders encountering one another,

sa: पौरजानपदान् सर्वान् विसृज्य कुरुनन्दनः। यौवराज्येन कौन्तेयं भीमसेनमयोजयत्॥
en: Having sent away the citizens and the people of the provinces, the Kuru king appointed his brother Bhimasena as Yuvaraja.

sa: यन्मन्त्रे भवति वृथोपयुज्यमाने यत् सोमे भवति वृथाभिषूयमाणे। यच्चाग्नौ भवति वृथाभिहूयमाने तत् सर्वं भवति वृथाभिधीयमाने॥
en: As Mantras applied for gaining victory, or the performance of the Soma sacrifice made without proper gifts, or oblations poured on the fire without proper hymns, become fruitless and produce evil results, so sin and evil results originate from falsehood.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच कृतानि मम सर्वाणि यस्या मे वेदवित्तम। त्वं प्रसन्नः पिता चैव कृतं विप्र वरैर्मम॥
en: Kunti said: O best of those versed in the Vedas, all my desires have been gratified in as much as you as well as my father are pleased with me. So, O Brahmana, I think I have already received boons.

sa: स शीघ्रतरमादाय धनुरन्यत् प्रतापवान्। द्रोणमभ्यहनद् राजंस्त्रिशता कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Thereupon that puissant hero (Satyajit), O monarch, having speedily grasped another bow, struck Drona with thirty arrows furnished with Kanka-feathers.

sa: गदाप्रहाराभिहतो हिमवानपि पर्वतः। सकृन्मया विदीर्येत गिरिः शतसहस्रधा॥
en: Struck by a blow from my mace, even the Himavat mountain can be split up into a hundred thousand pieces.

sa: त्रायन्ते संक्रमास्तत्र परसैन्यागते सति। यन्त्रैस्तैरवकीर्यन्ते परिखासु समन्ततः॥
en: On the approach of hostile forces, their attack is repulsed by these machines, and they are thrown into the ditch.

sa: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत्परमार्थवत्। प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Sugrīva's speech, reasonable and fraught with high sense, Kākutstha accorded his assent to it and spoke to Hanumān, saying.

sa: रश्मिभिर्भास्करो राजंस्तमांसीव समन्ततः। द्रोणेन वध्यमानानां पञ्चालानां विशाम्पते॥
en: Like the sun dispelling darkness with his rays. O ruler of men, when the Panchalas were being slaughtered by Drona.

sa: परितुष्टस्तु सुग्रीवस्तेन वाक्येन हर्षितः। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रजं शूरमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Sugrīva, rejoiced at the words of Rāma, said to that hero, the elder brother of Laksmana; who was well pleased.

sa: तथा सम्प्रेषयामास दूतान् नृपतिशासनात्। भीमसेनो महाबाहो राज्ञामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Bhimasena, at the command of the king, sent out messengers to the great kings of the Earth.

sa: प्रतिज्ञाय तदा तेषां मुनीनामुग्रतेजसाम्। स भ्रातृन्सहितान्सर्वानुवाच रघुनन्दनः।७।।
en: Having thus bound himself with that promise to the ascetics of fierce energy, Raghu's son along with his brothers spoke.

sa: ते भग्नमनसः सर्वे त्रैगर्तकमहारथाः। दिशोऽभिदुद्रुवू राजन् धनंजयशरार्दिताः॥
en: The powerful car-warriors of the Trigarlas, with dispirited hearts, fled in all directions, greatly afflicted by Dhananjaya with his arrows.

sa: अन्योन्यस्याभिसंक्रुद्धावन्योन्यं जनतुः शरैः। विनदन्तौ महारावान् सिंहाविव महाबलौ॥
en: Enraged with each other, the combatants pierced each other with their arrows and uttered loud roars like two powerful lions.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तद्वाक्यं मयोक्तः प्राह शङ्करः। ततो मां जगतो माता धारिणी सर्वपावनी॥ उवाचोमा प्रणिहिता शर्वाणी तपसां निधिः। दत्तो भगवता पुत्रः साम्बो नाम तवानघ।॥
en: Whereto Shankara said, so be it, repeating the words I had said. After this, the mother of the universe, the upholdress of all things, she who purifies all things, viz., the wife of Sarva that huge receptacle of penances, said with controlled soul, these words to me: The powerful Mahadeva has granted you, O sinless one, a son who shall be named Shamba.

sa: षडशीतिसहस्राणि योजनानां नराधिप। यमलोकस्य चाध्वानमन्तरं मानुषस्य च॥
en: O ruler of men, the distance of the region of Yama from the abode of men is eighty-six thousand yojanas.

sa: एषैव निष्ठा सर्वत्र यत् तदस्ति च नास्ति च। एतदन्त च मध्यं च सच्चासच्च विजानतः॥
en: This is the one conclusion of all the scriptures viz., that this universe exists and does not exist. To the man of knowledge this is both existent and non-existent. To him this all is both the end and the middle.

sa: विदेहराज्यं च तदा प्रतिष्ठाप्य सुतस्य वै। यतिधर्ममुपासंश्चाप्यवसन्मिथिलाधिपः॥
en: Installing his son in the sovereignty of the Videhas, the old king began to lead the life of a Yati.

sa: पुरोधसं च काकुत्स्थ नैगमानृत्विजस्तथा। मन्त्रिणश्चैव तान्सर्वानानयध्वं ममाज्ञया॥
en: And by my order do you summon the Purodhasas, O Kākutstha, and the citizens and the Rtvijas, and the councillors.

sa: द्विजातिपूर्वको लोकः क्रमेण प्रभविष्यति। ततः कालान्तरेऽन्यस्मिन् पुनर्लोकविवृद्धये॥
en: Creatures would come into existence again beginning with the Brahmanas. When that age will pass away, creation will again increase,

sa: महता शरवर्षेण गजं प्रति गजो यथा। तौ समेतौ नरव्याघ्रौ व्याघ्राविव तरस्विनौ॥ अन्योन्यं संततक्षाते रणेऽनुपमविक्रमौ। ततः कर्ण शिनेः पौत्रः सर्वपारसवैः शरैः॥ बिभेद सर्वगात्रेषु पुनः पुनररिंदम। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: With mighty discharges of arrows as an elephant smites (with his tusks) his rival elephant. Those two most valiant of mortals, as agile as tigers and endued with matchless strength wounded each other in that battle. Then the grandson of Sini by means of shafts made entirely of iron, pierced Karna, the chastiser of his foes, all through his body over and over again and with a broad headed arrows smote his (Karna's) charioteer from his niche in the car.

sa: यच्च तेऽन्तर्गतं वीर भयमर्जुनसम्भवम्। तत्रापि विहितोऽस्माभिर्वधोपायोऽर्जुनस्य वै॥
en: O hero, as for the fear of Arjuna in your heart, we have already settled the means of killing Arjuna.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे क्रोधेनाग्निरिव ज्वलन्। पितामहं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्वाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: Then Dhrishtadyumna blazing up with rage like fire, pierced the grandsire, with three shafts on the breast and the arms.

sa: विशीर्णैविप्रधावन्तो दृश्यन्ते स्म दिशो दश। नवमेघप्रतीकाशा जलदोपमनिःस्वनाः॥
en: The huge elephants ran in all the ten points of the compass, resembling newly-risen clouds.। and roaring also like them.

sa: तस्याः कुमाराश्चत्वारो जज्ञिरे रामपञ्चमाः। सर्वेषामजघन्यस्तु राम आसीज्जघन्यजः॥
en: Four sons were born of her, Rama being the fifth. Though the youngest, Rama became superior to all in merit.

sa: तमभ्यभाष सौमित्रे सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्। वाक्यज्ञं मधुरैर्वाक्यैः स्नेहयुक्तमरिन्दमम्॥
en: Do you welcome, with pleasant words, O Saumitri, this monkey-Sugrīva's minister, the subduer of foes, affectionate and skilled in speech.

sa: कर्कशाश्च विनीताश्च प्रभिन्नकरटामुखाः। जाम्बूनदमयैः सर्वे वर्मभिः सुविभूषिताः॥
en: Of tough hide, well-trained and shedding secretions from their temples and mouth and covered with armours made entirely of gold.

sa: प्रसुप्तेवाभवच्चापि भुवि सर्पविषार्दिता। भूयो मनोहरतरा बभूव तनुमध्यमा॥
en: The slender-waisted girl, as she lay on the ground as one asleep, looked more beautiful than she was when alive.

sa: नाश्वबन्धोऽश्वमाजानान्न गजं कुञ्जरग्रहः। मत्तप्रमत्तमुदिता सा चमूस्तत्र सम्बभौ॥
en: And the groom forgot his horse, and the elephant-keeper his elephant: that army there became transported with wine and exhilaration.

sa: अभिनन्दस्व नः सर्वाः प्रस्नुताः स्नेहविक्लवाः। तासां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा पातुकाम: स्तनान् प्रभुः॥ ताः सम्पूज्य महासेन: कामांश्चासां प्रदाय सः। अपश्यदग्निमायान्तं पितरं बलिनां बली॥
en: We are full of affection for you. We are desirous of giving you our breasts (to be sucked). The milk oozes out from our breasts." Having heard these words, the mighty Mahasena desired to suck their breasts. He received them with due respect and complied with their request. Then that mightiest of mighty ones saw that his father Agni was coming towards him.

sa: शिखिनीभिः परिवृतास्त एते मदमूर्च्छिताः॥ मन्मथाभिपरीतस्य मम मन्मथवर्धनाः।
en: These maddened peacocks encircled by the pea-hens, have been aggravating my amorous desire who am already possessed by the Cupid.

sa: हस्त्यनीकान्यतिष्ठन्त तथानीकानि वाजिनाम्॥ तथैव रथवाहिन्यः प्रतिव्यूह्य व्यवस्थिताः।
en: The elephant-division as also the horse division stood still, so also the car-divisions stood still, arranging themselves in battle array.

sa: तमुद्यम्य महातेजा निकुम्भोरसि वीर्यवान्। अभिचिक्षेप वेगेन वेगवान्वायुविक्रमः॥
en: With this, the powerful (monkey) gifted with great impetuosity, and resembling the wind in prowess, struck Nikumbha on his breast.

sa: एवं प्रशस्यमानौ तौ तप:श्लाघ्यैर्महर्षिभिः॥ संरक्ततरमत्यर्थं मधुरं तावगायताम्।
en: They two thus went on sweetly singing at a high pitch, praised by those mighty sages priding in their asceticism.

sa: ततो भीमस्त्रिभिर्विद्धवा कृतवर्माणमाशुगैः। शङ्ख दध्मौ महाबाहुर्हर्पयन् सर्वपाण्डवान्॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed Bhima piercing Kritavarman with three swift-coursing arrows, blew his conch-shell, imparting thereby delight unto the Pandava troops.

sa: दुःशासनादहं पूर्व सभायां मोचिता यथा। तथैव संकटादस्मान्मामुद्धर्तुमिहार्हसि॥
en: You did save me before from Dushasana in the assembly; it behoves you now to save me from this difficutly.

sa: इत्युक्तस्त्वब्रवीद् राजा तमुत्तकं पुनर्वचः। गच्छ मद्वचनाद् देवीं ब्रूहि देहीति सत्तम॥ सैवमुक्ता त्वया नूनं मद्वाक्येन शुचिव्रता। प्रदास्यति द्विजश्रेष्ठ कुण्डले ते न संशयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Thus addressed, the king once addressed Utanka and said to him, Do you, at my word, go to my venerable queen, O best of men, and ask her saying, Give!' She of pure Vows, thus begged by you will certainly, at my command, give you, O foremost of twice-born persons, those jewelled ear-rings of hers without doubt. more

sa: ततोऽदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः। अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्षामवातरत्।।१८
en: Thereupon being welcomed by the villagers on his way he reached Ayodhyā at noon and descended at the middle apartment.

sa: तस्मात् सर्वास्ववस्थासु मान्याः पूज्याश्च नित्यदा। त्वं तु धर्ममविज्ञाय केवलं मोहमाश्रितः॥ अभ्यागतं तु दौरात्म्यात् परुषं वदसीदृशम्। गुणदोषौ न पृच्छामि क्षेमं चात्मनि राक्षस॥
en: They are to be adored and honoured therefore on all occasions. You are ignorant of kingly morality and fully absorbed in illusion. It is for this that you do out of your wickedness of heart address me your guest with these harsh words. I do not ask you, O, Raksasa about the propriety (of my conduct) or about my welfare.

sa: रुम्णो नाम तेजस्वी विक्रान्तैर्वानरैर्वृतः॥ आगतो बलवांस्तूर्णं कोटीशतसमावृतः।
en: And (the monkey) named Rumna, possessed of energy, and strong, came swiftly, surrounded by an hundred koțis of powerful monkeys.

sa: राजा सत्यं च धर्मश्च राजा कुलवतां कुलम्। राजा माता पिता चैव राजा हितकारो नृणाम्॥
en: The king is truth, the king is morality, the king is the racial dignity of those possessed of the same, the king is the father, the king is the ON 68 RĀMĀYAŅAM mother, the king compasses the welfare of men.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुरगस्त्यं सूर्यवर्चसम्। जग्राहापततस्तस्य पादौ च रघुनन्दनः॥
en: Having said this touching Agastya of the splendour of the sun, that son of Raghu took hold of his feet.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे धनवन्तः सुरक्षिताः। शेरते विवृतद्वाराः कृषिगोरक्षजीविनः॥
en: In a kingless country, the wealthy are not well protected; nor do shepherds and cultivators sleep with their doors open.

sa: सामात्यपरिषत्क्रीडन् पानमेवोपसेवते। शोकदीनेषु नास्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम्॥
en: Does not Sugrīva feel pity for us, who are racked with sorrow, being addicted to drinking with friends and counsellors?

sa: समन्ततस्तदा देवीमभ्यषिञ्चत पावकः। सर्वस्रोतांसि पूर्णानि गङ्गाया रघुनन्दन॥
en: And then Pavaka from all sides discharged his energy into her, and thereat all her streams became surcharged with it,

sa: ततः समुद्रद्वीपांश्च सुभीमान् द्रष्टुमर्हथ। ऊर्मिमन्तं महारौद्रं क्रोशन्तमनिलोद्धतम्॥
en: Then it behoves you to examine horrible ocean islands, heaving with waves, terrific, resounding,-of haughty bearing in consequence of winds.

sa: सुहृद्वितीयो विक्रान्तः प्राज्ञः कालविशेषवित्। भवानस्मद्धिते युक्तः सुहृदाप्तोऽर्थवित्तमः॥
en: My second friend (Laksmana being first), you potent, wise, conversant with seasonableness, cognisant of profit, and engaged in our welfare.

sa: सर्वांश्चाहूय सुग्रीवः प्लवगान् प्लवगर्षभः। समस्तांश्चाब्रवीद् राजा रामकार्यार्थसिद्धये॥
en: Summoning all the monkeys, that foremost of monkeys, king Sugriva, spoke to them all touching the success of Rāma's work.

sa: शरैर्निभिन्नहृदयान् कुञ्जरांस्तुरगांस्तथा॥ श्वापदाः परिकर्षन्तु नरांश्च निहतान् मया।
en: The ferocious beasts shall drag away elephants and steeds and men slaughtered by me with arrows penetrating into their hearts.

sa: भरतश्च सशत्रुघ्नश्चीरवासा वनेचरः। वने वसन्तं काकुत्स्थमनुवत्स्यति पूर्वजम्॥
en: Bharata and Śatrughna wearing ascetic clothes and ranging the forest will live like their elder brother resident in the woods.

sa: भृशमाव्रजमानस्य तस्याधो वामलोचनम्। प्रास्फुरच्चास्खलद् रामो वेपथुश्चास्य जायते॥
en: As Rāma went on, his feet failed him, his left eye to beat, and a trembling came over his frame.

sa: स मुहूर्तमिवासंज्ञो दुःखितश्च महीपतिः। विललाप महाबाहू राममेवानुचिन्तयन्॥
en: Then remaining unconscious for a while, the mighty-armed lord of earth oppressed by grief began to bewail, thinking of Rāma.

sa: न ह्यनाथा वयं राज्ञा लोकनाथेन धीमता। भरतश्चापि धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः॥ भवतीमनुवर्तेत स हि धर्मरतः सदा।
en: That highly intelligent lord of men living, we should not consider ourselves as without a master. Bharata is also pious and beloved of all people in speech, he, intent on the performance of religious service, shall attend upon you always.

sa: अस्मीदानीमहं प्राप्ता हतश्रवणनासिका। शोणितौघपरिक्लिन्ना त्वया च परिसान्त्विता।७।।
en: Having had my nose and ears cut off, I had come hither, covered with blood; and you had consoled me.

sa: नीलाञ्जनचयाकारो नीलो नामैष यूथपः। अदृश्यत महाकायः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः॥
en: And the leader of herds, named Nīla, of huge body, resembling a mass of blue collyrium. appeared with ten kotis.

sa: पादुकााभिषेकं च नन्दिग्रामनिवासनम्। दण्डकारण्यगमनं विराधस्य वधं तथा॥
en: And the installation of the sandals; and Bharata's dwelling at Nandigrāma: and Rāma's removal to Dandaka and killing of Virādha.

sa: शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च पाशहस्ता महाबलाः। सृजन्तः शरवर्षाणि शस्त्रवर्षाणि संयुगे॥
en: And bearing in their hands darts, and clubs, and nooses, those exceedingly strong ones showered in battle shafts and weapons.

sa: द्रुमवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्त शिलावर्षाणि राक्षसाः। तद् बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्॥ रामस्यास्य महाघोरं पुनस्तेषां च रक्षसाम्।
en: And the Räkşasas discharged vollies of trees and crags. And capable of making one's hair stand on end, that battle was dreadful and furious and now on the side of Rāma and now again on : that of the Raksasas.

sa: साहं त्वदर्थे संप्राप्ता त्वं तु मां नावबुध्यसे। सपत्निवृद्धौ या मे त्वं प्रदेयं दातुमर्हसि ॥
en: You do not understand that I am taking such pains, and it is evident that you does not understand that I have come to you for your good. You are conferring on me rewards on the advancement of your co-wife.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा काञ्चनं यानं सुग्रीवः सूर्यसंनिभम्॥ बहुभिर्हरिभिर्युक्तमारुरोह सलक्ष्मणः।
en: Having said this, Sugrīva in company with Lakşınana swiftly ascended the golden car resembling the sun, yoked with numerous steeds.

sa: प्रगृह्य तु महीपालो जलापूरितमञ्जलिम्। दिशं याम्यामभिमुखो रुदन् वचनमब्रवीत्॥ एतत्ते राजशार्दूल विमलं तोयमक्षयम्। पितृलोकगतस्याद्य मद्दत्तमुपतिष्ठतु॥
en: The protector of the earth (Rama), holding water with his joined hands, facing the south, said weeping, “O foremost of monarchs, may this clear water knowing no deterioration, reach you, who have gone to the world of the ancestral manes.!"

sa: महीमहमिमां कृत्स्नामधितिष्ठन्तमात्मजम्। अनेन वयसा दृष्ट्वा यथा स्वर्गमवाप्नुयाम्॥
en: Therefore in this age, beholding my son established in (the dominion of) this entire earth, I shall repair to heaven.

sa: एवमुक्त्वाथ भरतं भार्यामभ्येत्य राघवः। उवाच शोकसंतप्तः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्॥
en: Having thus addressed Bharata, Rāghava burning in grief spoke to his wife, with her countenance resembling the full moon, saying.

sa: संवेष्टितमिवात्यर्थं गहनं मातरिश्वना। वनस्य तस्य शब्दोऽभूद् वनमापूरयन्निव॥
en: The forest was enveloped on all sides with a mighty wind and everywhere was audible a roar filling the wood-land.

sa: हरीणामुत्थितो मध्यात् सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। अभिवाद्य हरीन् वृद्धान् हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Rising in the midst of the monkeys, Hanumān has his down standing on end through joy, saluting the monkeys, said,

sa: पश्यामीहि हि कण्ठे त्वां कालपाशावपाशितम्। यथा चास्मिन् भयस्थाने न बिभेषि निशाचर॥ व्यक्तं हिरण्यमयांस्त्वं हि सम्पश्यसि महीरूहान्। नदी वैतरणी घोरां रुधिरौघविवाहिनीम्॥ खङ्गपत्रवनं चैव भीमं पश्यसि रावण। तप्तकाञ्चनपुष्पां च वैदूर्यप्रवरच्छदाम्॥
en: I see with the noose of Death wound round your neck. As, O ranger of night, you are not affected with fear, albeit the situation is one calculated to raise one's apprehensions it is clear that you will see the golden treus, the dreadful river Vaitaraṇī flowing with blood, the terrible wood, O Rāvana, rife with leaves in the shape of swords, and a sharp Šalmali containing blossoms of shining gold, having lapises for its leaves, and bearing iron thorns.

sa: सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवो महाबन्धुर्मतस्तव। भ्रातृसौहृदमालम्ब्य नान्या गतिरिहास्ति ते॥
en: Methinks, that large-necked Sugrīva is your best friend-there is no other resource for you than to secure your brother's friendship.

sa: धनानि व्यवसायेन विचीयन्ते महावने। धातवो विविधाश्चापि मणिरत्नसुवर्णिनः॥
en: Moreover while engaged in sporting they collect many a jewel and various metals as gold and silver, in the woods.

sa: कल्माषपादपुत्रोऽभूच्छङ्खणस्त्विति नः श्रुतम्। सहसैन्यो व्यनीनशत्॥ यस्तु तद्वीर्यमासाद्य
en: We have heard that Kalmāșapāda's son was Śarkhaņa, who having been endowed with prowess, found destruction along with his forces.

sa: ते साश्वरथपादाता वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। भस्मीकृता मुहूर्तेन विश्वामित्रसुतास्तथा॥
en: In a moment, Viśvāmitra's sons together with horse and car and foot were reduced to ashes by the high-souled Vasistha.

sa: तथा सीतामुपासीनामनसूया दृढव्रता। वचनं प्रष्टुमारेभे कथां काञ्चिदनुप्रियाम्॥
en: Then as Sītā was sitting, Anasūyā firm in vow asked her concerning a thing that was near her heart, saying.

sa: प्रसन्नसलिलाः सौम्य कुरराभिविनादिताः। चक्रवाकगणाकीर्णा विभान्ति सलिलाशयाः। ५९।।
en: O you of excellent looks, the ponds in this season) appear exquisitely fine, being filled with Kurara birds and Cakravākas.

sa: इन्द्रस्तु प्रहसन् वाक्यमहल्यामिदमब्रवीत्॥ सुश्रोणि परितुष्टोऽस्मि गमिष्यामि यथागतम्।
en: Indra too said to Ahalyā, 'O you of shapely hips, pleased am I. Now I repair to my own place.'

sa: सुतीक्ष्णेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं प्रस्थितं रघुनन्दनम्। हृद्यया स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the son of Raghu had set out with Sutiksna's permission, SItā addressed him in affectionate words and convincing speech.

sa: स दुःखवशमापनस्त्वसमञ्जसुतस्तदा। चुक्रोश परमार्तस्तु वधात् तेषां सुदुःखितः॥
en: And (arriving there), Asamañja's son, smitten with grief, and being exceedingly afflicted at their destruction, bewailed in heaviness of heart.

sa: ततो देवसखा नाम पर्वतः पतगालयः। नानापक्षिसमाकीर्णो विविधद्रुमभूषितः॥
en: Then (lies) the mountain called Devasakhā, the home of feathered tribes; abounding in various fowls, and embellished with diverse trees.

sa: भवानपि तथेत्येव पितरं सत्यवादिनम्। कर्तुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र क्षिप्रमेवाभिषिञ्चनात्॥
en: You too, you foremost of kings, should in the same way speedily render our father truthful, by getting yourself installed.

sa: स राघवं समासाद्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। व्यसृजच्छरवर्षाणि रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥
en: Approaching Rāghava, Rāvana the lord of Rakşasas, with his eyes reddened in ire, began to make a shower of arrows.

sa: तमापतन्तमुत्पत्य हनूमान्कपिकुञ्जरः॥ आजघान तदा मूर्ध्नि वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना।
en: As he rushed on, that foremost of monkeysHanuman-~-dealt on the crown of his head, a blow resembling the thunder-bolt itself.

sa: तत्र देवान्पितृन्विप्रानर्चयित्वा यथाविधि। बाह्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम जनैर्वृतः॥
en: And there having worshipped duly the celestials, manes and the Brahmans, he, encircled by men, came to the outer apartment.

sa: निबनीमोऽस्य पौरुषम्। हत्वा चास्य चमूं कृत्स्नां वशमेवानयामहे॥
en: Arranging our army we shall destroy his manliness; or completely destroying his army we shall bring him under our subjection.

sa: तस्य रामस्य सुप्तस्य कुशास्तीर्णे महीतले। नियमादप्रमत्तस्य निशास्तिस्रोऽभिजग्मतुः॥
en: As Rāma slept on the earth on Kuśa spread over, without ever swerving from the rule, three nights passed away.

sa: स वाजिभिश्चतुर्भिस्तु बाणैस्तु निशितैर्युतः। आरोपितमहाचापः शुशुभे स्यन्दनोत्तमे॥
en: It was drawn by four horses and a huge bow, set with sharp arrows, appeared beautiful on that excellent car.

sa: अनुज्ञातं तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महानादमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: Being commanded by Räma, that excellent car, drawn by ganders, with a huge noise, rose high up in the welkin.

sa: विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा नित्यं धर्मर्यवस्थितः। स्वाध्यायनियताहार उवास विजितेन्द्रियः॥
en: But the righteous Vibhișana, ever intent on piety, dwelt there studying the Veda, restraining his fare, and controlling his senses.

sa: अनुज्ञातं तु रामेण तद्विमानमनुत्तमम्। हंसयुक्तं महानादमुत्पपात विहायसम्॥
en: Being commanded by Räma, that excellent car, drawn by ganders, with a huge noise, rose high up in the welkin.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते भयार्दिताः। चोदयामासुरव्यग्रान्राक्षसांस्तानृपाज्ञया ॥
en: Hearing his speech-those Raksasa, possessed by fear, asked by the command of the king, the Rākşasa soldiers to be ready.

sa: सन्त्यन्याः प्रमदास्तुभ्यं रूणेणाभ्यधिकास्ततः। अनङ्गवशमापन्नस्त्वं तु मोहान बुद्ध्यसे॥
en: There are damsels in your sergalio far more beautiful than she but you possessed by cupid could not perceive this.

sa: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा भर्तुस्तेऽनुचरः प्रियः। कृतवाञ्छोकसंतप्तः शिरसा तेऽभिवादनम्॥
en: And the highly effulgent Lakşmaņa, the beloved follower of your husband, worn with grief, bows his reverential head to you.

sa: क्षिप्रं वज्रसमैर्बाणैः शतधा कार्मुकच्युतैः। राममादीपयिष्यामि उल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Like a meteor burning an elephant, I shall, with shafts shot from bow in hundreds, resembling the thunder-bolt, consume Rāma.

sa: ततस्तमृषिमायान्तमुद्यन्तमिव भास्करम्। अर्जुना दृश्य संभ्रान्तो ववन्देन्द्र इवेश्वरम्॥
en: And beholding the ascetic resembling the rising sun arrived, the King Arjuna bowed to him reverentially like Indra saluting Mahadeva.

sa: प्रव्रज्यामुपपन्नानां त्रयाणामेकमागतम्। परिप्रेक्ष्यति कौसल्या लक्ष्मणं शोकलालसा ॥
en: Kaucalya, over-whelmed with sorrow, shall only behold one of the three that had gone away to distant lands, come (back)-Laksmana.

sa: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च विरूपाक्षो महोदरः। उदतिष्ठन्सुसंरब्धाः सचिवास्तस्य रक्षसः॥
en: And wrought up with exceeding great wrath, the counsellors of that Rākşasas-Mārīca and Prahasta and Virūpākṣa and Mahodara-also rose up.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा शोकसंभ्रान्तो रामः शत्रुनिर्बहणः। हनूमन्तं महाबाहुस्ततो ध्यानमुपागमत्॥
en: Having said this to Hanumān, that slayer of foes, the mighty-armed Rāma, agitated by anxiety, was then plunged in thought.

sa: वैदेह्या यानि चाङ्गेषु तदा रामोऽन्वकीर्तयत्। तान्याभरणजालानि गात्रशोभीन्यलक्षयत्॥
en: I see at her person all these ornaments, of which Rāma mentioned to me at the time of my departure.

sa: स्वभावतनुका नूनं शोकेनानशनेन च। भूयस्तनुतरा सीता देशकालविपर्ययात्॥
en: Sītā is constitutionally slender, and forsooth, she has been greatly reduced by sorrow, fasting and calamities touching time and place.

sa: तां समीक्ष्य विशालाक्षी राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम्। तर्कयामास सीतेति कारणैरुपपादयन्॥।
en: And beholding that blameless daughter of the king, having expansive eyes, Hanumān, by various reasonings, reflected-“Forsooth she must be Sītā."

sa: इत्येवं तु वदन्वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। तस्मादवातरच्छीघ्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः॥
en: Having said this to Laksmana, Laksmana's elder brother possessed of exceeding strength, hastily descended from the top of the mountain.

sa: राक्षसानामधिपतिर्दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्॥ पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैः परमर्माभिभेदनैः। शरैरादीपयामास नीलं हरिचभूपतिम्॥
en: The powerful lord of Raksasas-the Tennecked one-made that general of forces-Nilaaflame with dreadful shafts entering into the vitals, resembling snakes.

sa: तस्यास्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। सीतायाः शोकतप्तायाः समीपमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing those words of $ītā, racked with sorrow, Hanumān, the son of the Wind-god drew a little nearer to her.

sa: संध्यामुपास्य विधिवत्तदा नरवरोत्तमः। प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां तु सोऽन्तःपुरचरोऽभवत्॥
en: The best among men performed duly the twilight ceremony (Sandhyā). He entered the gynaeceum when the night nad set in.

sa: सच कामपराधीनः पतिस्तासां महाबलः। सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ॥
en: And their might husband, brought under the control of amour and having his mind firmly attached to Şītā, proceeded slowly.

sa: धूम्राक्षवचनं श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षो बलानुगः। बलमुद्योजयामास रावणस्याज्ञया भृशम्॥
en: Hearing Dhumraksa's words, the general of the forces, following them, at the command of Rāvaņa forthwith made the army ready.

sa: अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा इन्द्रजित्समितिंजयः। अमरत्वमहं देव वृणे योष मुच्यते॥
en: Thereupon the highly powerful Indrajit-the subduer of enemies, said: "If do you say so, O god, I pray for immortality."

sa: प्रयान्तं नैर्ऋतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः। बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रियभार्यास्तमन्वयुः॥
en: And in this way those beloved wives, (of Ravana) having inebriate eyes, followed, out of amour and reverence, their husband.

sa: विद्युज्जिडं च मायाज्ञमब्रवीद्राक्षसाधिपः। मोहयिष्यावहे सीतां मायया जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: The lord of Rākşasas said to Vidyujjihva, skilled in illusion, Do you bring Janaka's daughter under the sway of illusion.

sa: संतुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः। प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधं युद्धलुब्धोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Thereat, well pleased with the speech of the charioteer, Ravana, eager for encounter, after praising him in various ways said.

sa: स तवादर्शनादार्ये राघवः परितप्यते। महता ज्वलता नित्यमग्निनेवाग्निपर्वतः॥
en: Rāghava burns in grief, O worshipful dame, in your absence, like to a volcanic mountain burning with a perpetual fire.

sa: विद्राव्य राक्षसं सैन्यं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। गिरेः शिखरमादाय धूम्राक्षमभिदुद्रुवे॥
en: Then Hanumān-son to the Wind-god-charged in full career against the Räkşasa army; and, taking a mountain-peak, he rushed against Dhumraksa.

sa: तस्य बाणैश्च चिच्छेद धनुर्गजकरोपमम्। लक्ष्मणो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पञ्चभिनिशितैस्तदा॥
en: Then with five sharpened arrows Lakşmaņa severed the bow the bow of the Räkşasa-chief, resembling the trunk of an elephant.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु वचसि रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। संघर्षमाणाः प्लवगाः सिंहनादैरपूरयन्॥
en: As Rāma of untiring deeds said this, the monkeys, filling (The air) with leonine roars, began to press forward furiously.

sa: राक्षसेन्द्रगजैस्तैस्तु क्षोभिता नर्मदा नदी॥ वामनाञ्जनपद्मद्यैर्गङ्गा इव महागजैः।
en: She was agitated by those elephant like leading Rākşasas like to the Gargā by Vămana, Anjana, Padma and other elephants.

sa: नीलजीमूतसंकाशं न्यग्रोधं भीमदर्शनम्। तेजस्वी रावणभ्राता लक्ष्मणाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: The energetic brother of Rāvana showed to Lakşmaņa the Nyagrodha, dreadful to behold and resembling a mass of sable clouds.

sa: ततः श्रान्ताहमुत्सङ्गमासीनस्य तवाविशम्। क्रुध्यन्तीव प्रहृष्टेन त्वयाह परिसान्त्विता॥
en: Thereupon, tired as I was, I sat on your lap, and, exercised with ire, I was consoled by you laughing.

sa: विप्रलम्बितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचध्वजम्। बलं राक्षसमालम्ब्य वानराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Then the monkeys hemmed in the Rākşasaforces, with their apparels falling off and with their mail and standards strewn around.

sa: वानराश्चापि संक्रुद्धाः प्राकारस्थान्महीं गताः। राक्षसान्पातयामासुः खमाप्लुत्य स्वबाहुभिः॥
en: And (thereat) the monkeys, flying into fury, descending to the earth and bounding, brought down the Rākşasas with their arms.

sa: शोणिताक्षस्ततः क्षिप्रमसिचर्म समाददे। उत्पपात तदा कुद्धो वेगवानविचारयन्॥
en: Thereat, Šoņitākṣa swiftly took up his sword and shield; and without reflecting for a moment, that vigorous one sprang forward.

sa: कौतूहलं समुत्पन्नो यास्यामि यमसादनम्। विमर्दै द्रष्टुमनयोर्यमराक्षसयोः स्वयम्॥
en: I am curious about it. To Yama's abode shall I go for witnessing the encounter between Yama and the Raksasa.

sa: पादचारमिवादित्यं निष्पतन्तं सुदुर्दृशम्। ततस्ते प्रत्यभिज्ञाय अर्जुनाय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: Beholding that dreadful Rșis approach like to Āditya walking on foot, the warders communicated the intelligence to the king Arjuna.

sa: प्रविश्य च पुरीं लङ्कामनुज्ञाप्य विभीषणम्। ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो हनूमान्वृक्षवाटिकाम्॥
en: Entering the city with Vibhișana'a permission, Hanumān, again permitted, entered the vşkşa Vatika.* *A garden in the city of Lankā.

sa: विषण्णवदना ह्येते त्यक्तप्रहरणा दिशः। पलायन्तेऽत्र हरयस्त्रासादुत्फुल्ललोचनाः ॥
en: These monkeys with sad faces, leaving their arms behind them are flying in all directions, their eyes distended in affright.

sa: पश्यतां वानरेन्द्राणां राघवस्यापि पश्यतः। दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्य सुग्रीवः सहसोत्थितः॥
en: On seeing the Raksasa-chief, Sugriva suddenly rose up in the sight of the lords of monkeys as well as Rāghava.

sa: रथशीर्षे महाभीमो गृध्रश्च निपपात ह॥ ध्वजाग्रे ग्रथिताश्चैव निपेतुः कुणपाशनाः। रुधिराो महाश्वेतः कबन्धः पतितो भुवि॥
en: And an exceedingly terrific vulture alighted at the crest of the car and forming themselves into lines, vultures began to drop down about the top of the banner. And emitting a frightful cry, (a headless trunk) dropped down before Dhumraksa.

sa: स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलो हरिचमूपतिः। करेणैकेन शैलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतयेऽसृजन्॥
en: Assailed with shafts, Nila-leader of monkeyswith one arm took up a mountain-top and hurled it at the lord of Rākşasa.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यो हि तत्रासनाघावार्ये समुद्यताः। भरतस्याज्ञयानेकाः : प्रहृष्टबलवाहनाः॥
en: And being prepared to help Rāma many Akşauhiņī soldiers with many steeds waited at Ayodhya at the command of Bhärata.

sa: अथ मङ्गलवादित्रैः शब्दैः श्रोत्रमनोहरैः। प्राबोध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः॥
en: And thereupon the mighty Ten-headed Rākṣasa, having huge arms, awoke with the sounds of those auspicious instruments, pleasant to ears.

sa: ततो रामः सुवेलाग्रं योजनद्वयमण्डलम्। उपारोहत्ससुग्रीवो हरियूथैः समन्वितः॥
en: Then Rāma, accompanied by the monkeyleaders, along with Sugrīva, ascended the top of Suvela, measuring a circumference of two Yojanas.

sa: हनूमता वेगवता कम्पितास्ते नगोत्तमाः। पुष्पपत्रफलान्याशु मुमुचुः फलशालिनः॥
en: And shaken by Hanumān vehemently moving about, those excellent trees crowned with fruits, speedily cast off fruits, flowers and foliage.

sa: ततः संवर्तयामास वामहस्तस्य सोऽङ्गुलीः। मुष्टिनाभिजघानैनां हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥
en: And (Hanuman) fastened the fingers of his left hand into a box, and transported with rage, dealt it to her.

sa: तमापतन्तं ज्वलितं खरपुत्रकराच्च्युतम्॥ बाणैश्चतुर्भिराकाशे शूलं चिच्छेद राघवः।
en: Rāghava, with four shafts, sundered that dart, in the sky, flaming and hurled at him by the son of Khara.

sa: एवमुक्तो दश्ग्रीवः कोपसंरक्तलोचनः॥ हस्तान्दन्तांश्च संपिष्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।
en: Thus addressed, the Ten necked one, with his eyes reddened in wrath, rubbing his hands and knashing his teeth, said.

sa: बाहविक्षेपकरणां समुद्यम्य महागदाम्। ग्रागडं वैमास्थाय आपपातैव सोऽर्जुनः॥
en: Holding up the huge club and hurling it with his arms, Arjuna, resorting to the velocity of Garuda, went on

sa: चित्रांश्च रुचिरान्मार्गाश्चेरतुः कपिराक्षसौ। जघ्नतुश्च तदान्योन्यं नर्दन्तौ जयकाङ्गिणौ॥
en: The monkey and the Rākşasa displayed curious and graceful movements. And attacking each other, they gave shouts eager for victory.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुक्रूरं रामरावणयोस्तदा। सुमहद्वैरथं युद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम्॥
en: Thereupon there ensued a mighty and dreadful encounter of two cars between Rāma and Ravana, creating terror to all people.

sa: त्वमस्माकं चतुर्णां वै भ्राता सुग्रीवपञ्चमः। सौहृदाज्जायते मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम्॥
en: O Sugrīva, you are our fifth brother. From brotherliness grow friendship and doing injury is the sign of an enemy.

sa: महता पक्षवातेन सर्वद्वीपमहाद्रुमाः। निपेतुर्भग्नविटपाः सलिले लवणाम्भसि ॥
en: And mighty trees of the ocean-islands, broken down by-the terrible wing-raised wind, began to topple headlong into the salt waters.

sa: अस्त्राण्यस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठौ दर्शयन्तौ पुनः पुनः। शरानुच्चावचाकारानन्तरिक्षे बबन्धतुः॥
en: Those foremost of those acquainted with weapons repeatedly displayed their weapons; and their long and short shafts enveloped the welkin.

sa: ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना। निहतः पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः।४६॥
en: His chariot drawn by serpents was pulled down and destroyed by the high-souled Vasu by means of his huge shafts.

sa: आत्मानं त्वप्रहरणं ज्ञात्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः। शैलमुत्पाटयामास वेगेन हरिपुंगवः॥
en: And thinking that he was unfurnished with any arms, that foremost of monkeys, waxing wroth, vehemently rooted up a hill.

sa: मरुद्रोधाद्विनिर्मुक्तास्ताः प्रजा मुदिताभवन्। शीतवातविनिर्मुक्ताः पद्मिन्य इव साम्बुजाः।६॥
en: Having released from the confinement of Vāyu, all the creatures became happy like lotus flowers when rid of cold winds.

sa: महाप्रमाणमुद्यम्य विपुलं वेगवदृढम्। धनुर्भीमबलो भीमं शरांश्चामित्रनाशनान् ॥
en: That one endowed with terrific strength upraised a huge, gigantic, strong and powerful bow, and shafts capable of destroying foes.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे लगायां कृतार्थे रावणात्मजे। राघवं परिवार्याथ ररक्षुर्वानरर्षभाः॥
en: When Rāvana's son entered Lankā, after having accomplished his purpose, the foremost monkeys protected Raghava, surrounding him on all sides.

sa: स पूज्यमानो रक्षोभिर्दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा। आसनस्थं महाबाहुर्ववन्दे धनदानुजम्॥
en: The mighty-armed (Vibhisana) saluted the younger brother of the bestower of riches, * seated there. *Kuvera-Ravana was Kuvera's younger brother.

sa: तस्मादियं नरवात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण मया प्रदिष्टा। लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदितापि शुद्धा॥
en: You have been afraid of the public calumny. O son of a king, your mind being possessed by the fear of public scandal regarding her husband as a god; I came to know this by virtue of my discriminative knowledge.

sa: सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः। भवन्ति बहुविघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि॥
en: And let your friends vigilantly protect you all around, for many are the impediments that happen in affairs like this.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्त्वङ्गदीयायां संवत्सरमथोषितः। पुत्र स्थिते दुराधर्षे अयोध्यां पुनरागमत्॥
en: Having spent a year in Angada's city and finding his son well established in the kingdom Lakşmana returned to Ayodhyā.

sa: एतां पश्य दुराधर्षां मायाबलसमन्विताम्। विनिवृत्तां करोम्यद्य हृतकर्णाननासिकाम्॥
en: Mark! This irrepressible one, possessing all the resources of illusion, will I oppose, and deprive her of ears and nose.

sa: क्व च युद्धं विमर्दो वा मन्त्रे सुव्याहतानि च। क्व च भीष्मो गतवया मन्दात्मा कालचोदितः॥
en: How vast is the difference between real fight, the clash of weapons, good advice, uttered in sweet sounding words on one side and Bhishma who is past the prime of life, of wicked soul and who is urged by fate.

sa: एतदेवेदृशं पुण्यमरण्यं ब्राह्मणा विदुः। विदित्वा चानुतिष्ठन्ति क्षेत्रज्ञेनानुदर्शिना॥
en: Such is that sacred forest that is understood by Brahmanas, and understanding it, they live as directed by the Kshetrajna.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च हयानीकमभिद्रुतौ। ते हयाः काञ्चनापीडा रुक्मभाण्डपरिच्छदाः॥
en: Nakula and Sahadeva, both together, charged the cavalry-division. Those horses decked with golden chains and caparisons of the same metal.

sa: संतापाद भ्रश्यते चायुर्धर्मश्चैव सुरेश्वर। विनीय खलु तद् दुःखमागतं वैमनस्यजम्॥ ध्यातव्यं मनसा हृद्यं कल्याणं संविजानता।
en: Forsooth, suppressing that sorrow which comes upon oneself and which is begotten by a weak mind, one endued with true knowledge should reflect in his mind of that which yields the highest good not which lives in the heart itself.

sa: एतान्येव यथोक्तानि बुध्येथास्त्रिदशाधिप। पुरुषाणां प्रदुष्टानां स्वभावो बलवत्तरः॥
en: Keep in your heart these sayings, O king of the gods! The nature of wicked men can never be concealed.

sa: रोदनादतिनिःश्वासाद् भूमिसंस्पर्शनादपि। न त्वां देवीमहं मन्ये राज्ञः संज्ञावधारणात्॥ व्यञ्जनानि हि ते यानि लक्षणानि च लक्षये। महिषी भूमिपालस्य राजकन्या च मे मता॥
en: Yet by your tears and sighs, by the earth you are treading and by calling on a monarch's name it appears that you are not a celestial. (The celestials never shed tears nor touch the ground when they walk.) But from the marks on your person it appear that you are either the consort or the daughter of a king.

sa: अन्तरिक्षचराणां च दानवोत्तम पक्षिणाम्। उत्तिष्ठते यथाकालं मृत्युर्बलवतामपि॥
en: O best of Danavas, death comes in season even to the strongest of winged creatures which float in the air.

sa: तन्निघ्नन्तं महातेजा बभ्रुः परपुरंजयः॥ दारुकश्चैव दाशार्हमूचतुर्यन्निबोध तत्।
en: Hear, O king, what that conqueror of hostile towns, viz., Vabhru of great energy, and Daruka, then said to Krishna.

sa: त्यागं श्रेष्ठं मुनयो वै वदन्ति सर्वश्रेष्ठं यच्छरीरं त्यजन्तः। नित्यं युक्ता राजधर्मेषु सर्वे प्रत्यक्षं ते भूमिपाला यथैव॥ बहुश्रुत्वा गुरुशुश्रूषया चा परस्परं संहननाद् वदन्ति। नित्यं धर्मं क्षत्रियो ब्रह्मचारी चरेदेको ह्याश्रमं धर्मकामः॥
en: Making gifts is said by the sages to be the greatest of virtues. Of all kinds of gifts again, that of the body in battle, is the highest. You have seen with your own eyes how the kings, ever following Kshatriya duties, having duly waited upon their preceptors and acquired great learning, at last sacrifice their bodies, while fighting with one another. The Kshatriya, desirous of earning religious merit, should after following the Brahmacharya mode, live like a house-holder which is always meritorious.

sa: एवं स्तुवन्नपि नागान्यदा ते कुण्डले नालभत्तदाऽपश्यत्स्त्रियौ तन्त्रे अधिरोप्य सुवेमे पटं वयन्त्यौ। तस्मिंस्तन्त्रे कृष्णाः सिताश्च तन्तवश्चक्रं चापश्यत् द्वादशारं षड्भिः कुमारैः परिवर्त्यमानं पुरुषं चापश्यदश्वं च दर्शनीयम्॥ स तान्सर्वांस्तुष्टाव एभिर्मन्त्रवदेव श्लोकैः।
en: When he saw that he did not get the earrings, although he had worshipped the Nagas, he looked around him and beheld two women working in a loom with fine shuttle and weaving a piece of cloth. There were black and white threads in the loom. He also saw a wheel, with twelve spokes, which was turned round by six boys. He also saw a man with a horse. In order to please them all he uttered the following Mantras.

sa: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः। क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः॥
en: That destroyer of Rākşasas, O daughter of Vaidehi, environed by thousands of millions of monkeys, will come hither without delay.

sa: ततः कन्याश्रमं गच्छेन्नियतो ब्रह्मचर्यवान्। त्रिरात्रोपोषितो राजन् नियतो नियताशनः॥ लभेत् कन्याशतं दिव्यं स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति।
en: One should then go with regulated vows and with the life of Brahmacharya to Kanyasrama. O king, living there three nights with regulated diet and subdued soul. One obtains one hundred celestials damsels and goes to the region of Brahma.

sa: जयो नामेतिहासोऽयं श्रोतव्यो मोक्षमिच्छता। ब्राह्मणेन च राज्ञा च गर्भिण्या चैव योषिता॥ स्वर्गकामो लभेत् स्वर्ग जयकामो लभेज्जयम्। गर्भिणी लभते पुत्रं कन्यां वा बहुभागिनीम्॥ अनागतश्च मोक्षश्च कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः। संदर्भ भारतस्यास्य कृतवान् धर्मकाम्यया।॥ षष्टिं शतसहस्राणि चकारान्यां स संहिताम्।
en: A Brahmana desirous of emancipation, A Kshatriya desirous of ruling and a pregnant women desirous of having a son should listen to this history named as Jaya. One who desires the heaven achieve the same and the man desirous of victory in war achieve the same and pregnant women gets an able son or a luckiest daughter, In case, these recite or listen to this Bharata. The renowned sage Krishna Dvaipayana has composed this Bharata in order to establish the rightiousness, because he himself was in the form of emancipation. He made another compilation consisting of sixty lakh of verses.

sa: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपः क्रियाः। प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्॥
en: Therefore, uttering the syllable, Om, all utterers of Brahma begin their sacrifices, fits and penances, as ordained in the Shastras.

sa: नहि धर्मात्मनस्तस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। स्वचरित्राभिगुप्तां तां स्प्रष्टुमर्हति पावकः॥
en: Fire should not touch the spouse of that virtuous one of immeasurable energy, who is protected by her own character.

sa: ऊरुभिश्च नरेन्द्राणां विनिकृत्तैर्महाहवे। हस्तिहस्तोपमैरन्यैः संवृतं तद् रणाङ्गणम्॥
en: The battle-field-was covered with the things of kings, cut off in that battle and looking like the trunk of elephants.

sa: एष फुल्लार्जुनः शैलः केतकैरभिवासितः। सुग्रीव इव शान्तारिर्धाराभिरभिषिच्यते॥
en: This hill, having blown Arjunas and Ketakas and rid of its enemies like to Sugriva, has been bathed with showers.

sa: अन्याः स्रवन्तु मैरेयं सुरामन्याः सुनिष्ठिताम्। अपराश्चोदकं शीतमिक्षुकाण्डरसोपमम्॥
en: And let others run Maireya, and others refined wine, and others again cool waters resembling the juice of the sugarcane.

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च। प्रजापते मत्प्रसादात् फलभागी भविष्यसि॥
en: Through my grace, O progenitor of creatures, you will acquire the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices, and a hundred Vajapeyas.

sa: ततः सर्वे महात्मानः सहस्राक्षपुरोगमाः। तदारण्यमुपाक्रामन्यत्र वृत्रो महासुरः॥
en: There upon the highly powerful immortals headed by Indra entered the forest where the great Asura Vſtra was performing austerities.

sa: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गैस्तैस्तदायोधन बभौ॥ कबन्धैः संवृतं सर्वे ताम्राभैः खमिबावृतम्।
en: The field of battle overspread with headless trunks bathed in blood, appeared charming like the firmament overspread with coppery clouds.

sa: सम्पातिवचनाच्चापि रामं यद्यानयाम्यहम्। अपश्यन् राघवो भार्यां निर्दहेत्सर्ववानरान्॥
en: If in consonance with Sampat's speech, I bring Rāma hither, Rāghava, not seeing his wife, shall burn all the monkeys.

sa: मुक्तासमाभं सलिलं पतद् वै सुनिर्मलं पत्रपुटेषु लग्नम्। हृष्टा विवर्णच्छदना विहंगाः सुरेन्द्रदत्तं तृषिताः पिबन्ति ॥
en: The birds, having their wings discoloured, being wet with water, delighted and thirsty, are drinking the drops of clear water, falling on leaves and discharged by the Lord of celestials*. *According to Hindu mythology Indra is the god of rains.

sa: बाहूनुच्छ्रित्य कृपणा नेत्रप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः। रुदत्यः शोकसंतप्ताः कृपणं पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: And raising their arms, with tears trickling down their faces, they in dire affliction and extremely exercised with grief, lamented.

sa: एवमेतानि दुःखानि तानि तानीह मानवम्। विविधान्युपपद्यन्ते गात्रसंस्पर्शजान्यपि॥
en: Such a man is then overwhelmed with many other afflictions of a like nature that originate in fire and weapons.

sa: पञ्चम्यां वापि षष्ठ्यां च पौर्णमास्यां च भारत। उपोष्य एकभक्तेन नियतात्मा जितेन्द्रियः॥ क्षमावान् रूपसम्पन्नः श्रुतवांश्चैव जायते। नानपत्यो भवेत् प्राज्ञो दरिद्रो वा कदाचन॥
en: The wise man who, with his senses and soul under restraint, O Bharata, fasts, by abstaining from one of the two meals, on the fifth and the sixth days of the moon as also on the day of the full moon, becomes gifted with forgiveness and personal beauty and knowledge of scriptures. Such a person never becomes childless and poor.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रमुपातिष्ठद् विदुरः संजयस्तथा। वैश्यपुत्रश्च मेधावी युयुत्सुः कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Vidura, Sanjaya and the highly intelligent Yuyutsu, who was Dhritarashtra's son by his Vaishya wife, used to wait upon Dhritarashtra.

sa: किंचेदं महदाश्चर्यं सम्पश्यामीत्यचिन्तयत्। एवं संचिन्तयन्नेव ददर्श मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: 0, what are these wonderful spectacles that I see! Reflecting thus, the king at last saw that foremost of Rishis.

sa: तिर्यग्योनि न गच्छेच्च नरकं संकराणि च। न च दुःखभयं तस्य मरणे स न मुह्यति॥
en: Such a never takes birth in the intermediate order of being never goes to hell and never becomes a human being of any of the mixed castes. He has never to fear any calamity. When death comes, he becomes stupefied.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भृगुणा मैत्रावरुणिरव्ययः। अगस्त्यः परमप्रीतो बभूव विगतज्वरः॥
en: Thus addressed by Bhrigu, Mitravaruna's son Agastya of unfading power and glory, became highly pleased and freed from every anxiety.

sa: एतदेवेदृशं सूक्ष्मं ब्रह्मचर्यं विदुर्बुधाः। विदित्वा चान्वपद्यन्त क्षेत्रज्ञेनानुदर्शिताः॥
en: Brahmacharya is so subtle, understood by the wise. Having understood it, they followed it, instructed by the Kshetrajna. even as

sa: य एवं नैव कुप्यन्ते न लुभ्यन्ति तृणेष्वपि। त एव नः पूज्यतमा ये चापि प्रियवादिनः॥
en: Those persons who do not give way to anger and who never desire to take even a blade of grass belonging to others, as also they who are of sweet speech, deserve to receive from us the most respectful adorations.

sa: विभावसुः प्रज्वलितो वामं विपरिवर्तते। नीललोहितमञ्जिष्ठा विसृजन्नर्चिषः पृथक्॥
en: Fires, when ignited cast their flames towards the left. Sometimes they threw out flames whose colour was blue and red.

sa: इतरस्तु जनः सर्वस्ते चैव परमर्षयः। प्रतिजग्मुर्यथाकामं धृतराष्ट्राभ्यनुज्ञया॥
en: The common people and all the great Rishis, sent away by Dhritarashtra, came back to the places they respectively wished.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच विवक्षू हि युवां मन्ये वीरौ यदुकुरुद्वहौ। बूतं कर्तास्मि सर्वे वां नचिरान्मा विचार्यताम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You heroes, you foremost ones of Yadu's and Kuru's race, it appears that you two are desirous of saying something to me. Do you say what is in your mind. I shall soon satisfy it. Do not hesitate.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कां तु ब्राह्मणपूजायां व्युष्टिं दृष्ट्वा जनाधिप। कं वा कर्मोदयं मत्वा तानसि महामते।।।।
en: Yudhishthira said 'Tell us, o king, what is that reward of the worship of Brahmanas, seeing which you adore them, O you of superior intelligence! Indeed, what is that success, emanating from their adoration, guided by which you worship them?

sa: दृष्टस्तेऽहं प्रतिगच्छस्व तात शोचत्यसौ तव देहस्य कर्ता। ददानि किं चापि मन:प्रणीतं प्रियातिधेस्तव कामान् वृणीष्व॥
en: You have seen me. Do you go hence, O child. The author of your body is bewailing for you. You are my dear guest. What wish of yours shall I fulfil? Solicit the fruition of whatever desire you may have.

sa: तस्य वेगमसा तमसहन्ती वसुन्धरा। दण्डकाष्ठाभिनुन्नाङ्गी चचाल भृशमाकुला॥
en: The goddess Earth, unable to bear the force of Utanka's walking staff and with body torn therewith, became greatly anxious.

sa: पुष्करं च प्रभासं च नैमिषं सागरोदकम्। देविकामिन्द्रमार्गं च स्वर्णबिन्दुं विगाह्य च॥ विबोध्यते विमानस्थः सोऽप्सरोभिरभिष्टुतः।
en: By bathing in Pushkara, Prabhasa and Naimisha, and the ocean and Devika, and Indramarga and Svarnabindu, one is sure to ascend where, seated on a celestial car, one is sure be filled with joy on being worshipped by the Apsaras

sa: स्थावराणां च भूतानां जातयः षट् प्रकीर्तिताः। वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्ल्यस्त्वक्सारास्तृणजातयः॥
en: Of immobile objects, six classes have been spoken. They are Vrikshas, Gulmas, Latas, Vallis, Tvaksaras, and Trinas of diverse kinds.

sa: ब्राह्मणान् वाचयामासुर्गोविन्दस्यैव शासनात्। ततस्ता मुदिताः सर्वाः प्रशाशंसुर्जनार्दनम्॥
en: At the command of Govinda, the Brahmanas were made to utter benedictions. All the ladies filled with joy, lauded Janardana.

sa: प्रमृद्य परराष्ट्राणि कृतार्थं पुनरागतम्। पुत्रमाश्लिष्य भीष्मस्तु हर्षादश्रुण्यवर्तयत्॥
en: Bhishma also shed tears of joy and embraced his son who had returned victorious after subjugating many kingdoms of others.

sa: प्रविश्य नगरीं चापि ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिभिर्वृतः। अभिषिच्य जरासंधं मगधाधिपतिस्तदा॥
en: The Magadha king then re-entered his capital; and summoning all his friends and relatives, he installed Jarasandha on the throne.

sa: पञ्चवर्षसहस्राणि राजा दीक्षामथाकरोत्। इन्द्रयज्ञावसाने तु वसिष्ठो भगवानृषिः॥
en: There upon having finished the sacrifice of Indra there come to the King, the blameless and the illustrious Rși Vasiştha.

sa: सुखपुण्याहघोषस्य पुण्यस्य समनन्तरम्। विविशुर्विविधं गृह्य शस्त्रोपकरणं नराः॥
en: After auspicious and sweet-sounding musical instruments had struck up as propitiatory ceremony, men equipped with various weapons entered the arena.

sa: मैवमित्यब्रवीत्कृष्णः शमयंस्तस्य तद्वचः। यत्रास्त्रमस्त्रेण च तच्छमयामास फाल्गुनः॥
en: Krishna neutralised the words by saying, “This shall not be," and Arjuna neutralised the weapon by one of his own.

sa: ते धूमसंघा: संभूता मेघसंघा: सविद्युतः। अभ्यवर्षन्सुरगणान् श्रमसंतापकर्शितान्॥
en: From these vapours were created clouds with lightning; and they poured showers on the tired celestials who were thus refreshed.

sa: द्रौपद्यास्तनयानां च संभवोऽनुप्रकीर्तितः। विहारार्थं च गतयोः कृष्णयोर्यमुनामनु॥
en: The birth of the children of Draupadi; the pleasure trip of Arjuna and Krishna to the banks of the Yamuna;

sa: कच उवाच अनियोज्ये नियोगे मां नियुनसि शुभव्रते। प्रसीद सुभु त्वं मह्यं गुरोर्गुरुतरा शुभे॥ यत्रोषितं विशालाक्षि त्वया चन्द्र निभानने। तत्राहमुषितो भद्रे कुक्षौ काव्यस्य भामिनि॥ भगिनी धर्मतो मे त्वं मैवं वोचः सुमध्यमे। सुखमसम्युषितो भद्रे न मन्युर्विद्यते मम॥
en: Kacha said: O lady of virtuous vows, do not urge me into such a sinful course. O lady of fair eyebrows, be graceful to me. O amiable lady, you are an object of greater regard than my preceptor. O large-eyed lady, O lady of handsome face, O amiable maiden, the place the body of the son of Kavi, (Shukra) where you live, is also my abode. You are truly my sister. O slender-waisted lady, O_amiable maiden, do not say so. We have most happily passed the days we have lived together. There is perfect good feeling now existing between us.

sa: सारिसृक्क उवाच माता प्रणष्टा पितरं न विद्यः पक्षा जाता नैव नो धूमकेतो। स्तस्मादस्मांस्त्राहि बालांस्त्वमग्ने॥
en: Sarisrikka said: O smoke-banned deity, we cannot see our mother; we know not our father. Our feathers have not grown as yet. We have no one except you who can protect us. We are infants, therefore, O Agni protect us.

sa: तदपश्यमहं भ्रातुरसाम्प्रतमनुव्रजन्। विमर्श संकरादाने नायं कुर्यात् कदाचन॥
en: I was following him and I saw this unworthy act of my brother. He never scruples to take impure things.

sa: यदाश्रौषं श्रान्तमेकं शयानं ह्रदं गत्वा स्तम्भयित्वा तदम्भः। दुर्योधनं विरथं भग्नशक्तिं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Duryodhana, having been spent with fatigue, his strength being gone out and without even a chariot, had gone to a lake and had taken refuge in its waters.

sa: पतिभिर्निर्जितामुर्वी विक्रमेण महाबलैः। कुरु ब्राह्मणसात् सर्वामश्वमेधे महाक्रतौ॥
en: Let the whole earth, conquered by your greatly powerful husbands, be given to the Brahmanas in a great Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: तमुद्धर्तुमशक्ता वै सर्वे देवगणास्तदा। विष्णुमासीनमभ्येत्य ब्रह्माणं चेदमब्रुवन्॥
en: The celestials, having failed to uproot it, came to Vishnu and Brahma who were sitting together and said to them.

sa: ततो बलमतिख्यातं धार्तराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान्। भीमसेनस्य तज्ज्ञात्वा दुष्टभावमदर्शयत्॥
en: Seeing these extraordinary exhibitions of strength by Bhima, the mighty armed eldest of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana), the conceived hostility towards him.

sa: पशुवच्चैव तान्पृष्ठे वाहयामास वीर्यवान्। कारयामास चेन्द्रत्वमभिभूय दिवौकसः॥ तेजसा तपसा चैव विक्रमेणौजसा तथा। यतिं ययाति संयातिमायातिमयति ध्रुवम्॥ नहुषो जनयामास षट्सुतान्प्रियवादिनः। यतिस्तु योगमास्थाय ब्रह्मभूतोऽभवन्मुनिः॥
en: And like animal, the powerful one Nahusha carried them on the back of Rishis. Beating the very dwellers of heaven with his beauty, his asceticism, his prowess and energy, he ruled the earth, as if he was Indra himself. Nahusha begot six sweet-speeched sons, namely, Yati, Yayati, Sanyati, Aayati, Ayati and Dhruva. Yati adopted asceticism and became a great Rishi like Brahma himself.

sa: भीमश्चित्ररथश्चैव विख्यातः सर्वविद्वशी। तथा शालिशिरा राजन्पर्जन्यश्च चतुर्दशः॥
en: Bhima and Chitraratha, all greatly famous, learned and self-controlled, then O king, was Shalishira, then fourteenth in the least, Parjanya,

sa: पितरं गुरुभूतं मां यस्मात्त्वमवमन्यसे। राक्षसान्यातुधानांस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि दारुणान्॥
en: I am your father and preceptor and still you have disregarded me. You shall be the father of dreadful Räksasas.

sa: ऐन्द्रद्युम्नमुपाख्यानं धौन्धुमारं तथैव च। पतिव्रतायाश्चाख्यानं तथैवाङ्गिरसं स्मृतम्॥
en: Then come the stories of Indradyumna and Dhundumara, then the story of the chaste wife and the history of Angirasa.

sa: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः। बृहस्पति सभाज्येदं कचं वचनमब्रुवन्॥
en: Seeing him arrived, the celestials with Indra at their head looked with delight towards Brihaspati and spoke to him thus.

sa: कृतोदकांस्तानादाय पाण्डवाञ्छोककर्शितान्। सर्वाः प्रकृतयो राजन् शोचमाना न्यवारयन्॥
en: When the water ceremony was over, the people, themselves filled with grief, began to console the bereaved sons of Pandu.

sa: अहत्वा सर्वपञ्चालान् धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमान्। पाण्डवांश्च सहामात्यान्न विमोक्ष्यामि दंशनम्॥
en: "I will not take off my armour without killing all the Panchalas with Dhristadyumna and the Pandavas with their allies."

sa: ययातिरुवाच न तुल्यतेजाः सुकृतं कामयेत् योगक्षेमं पार्थिव पार्थिवः सन्। श्चरेनृशंसं न हि जातु राजा॥
en: Yayati said : O king, no king of equal energy should ever desire to accept in gift the religious merits of another king acquired by Yoga. No king, if wise, should act in a censurable way, though afflicted with calamity.

sa: दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः। शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः॥
en: From the east Răghava proceeded towards the south and espied a big tank by the side of the Saivala mountain.

sa: तोयकर्माणि चारब्धे राज्ञामुदकदानिके। गूढोत्पन्नस्य चाख्यानं कर्णस्य पृथयात्मनः॥
en: When the presentation of water to the deceased princes was commenced, Kunti acknowledged Karna as her son born in secret.

sa: अकीर्तिर्यस्य गीयेत लोके भूतस्य कस्यचित्॥ पतत्येवाधमाल्लोकान्यावच्छब्दः प्रकीर्त्यते।
en: He, who is notorious on this earth and as long as that notoriety remains current, is classed among the vile.

sa: सौतिरुवाच श्रुत्वा तु सर्पसत्राय दीक्षितं जनमेजयम्। अभ्यगच्छदृषिविद्वान्कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तदा।॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard that Janamejaya has been installed in the Snake-sacrifice, the learned Rishi Krishna Dvaipayana went there.

sa: तथैव राजा वृष्णीनामुग्रसेनः प्रतापवान्। अनुगीयमानो गन्धर्वैः स्त्रीसहस्रसहायवान्॥
en: There was the powerful king of the Vrishnis, Ugrasena, accompanied by his one thousand wives and followed by the Gandharvas.

sa: यस्मादवध्यां मे पत्नीमवधीः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। तस्मात्त्वं मानुषे लोके जनिष्यसि जनार्दन॥ तत्र पत्नीवियोगं त्वं प्राप्स्यसे बहुवार्षिकम्।
en: Being beside yourself with anger you have slain my wife, not worthy of being killed; therefore, O Janārddana, you shall be born in the region of mortals. And there you shall remain separated from your spouse for many long years.

sa: ततोऽपश्यत्स पितरं पृष्ठश्चाख्यातवान्पितुः। यथान्यायममेयात्मा तं चोवाच महानृषिः॥
en: He then saw his father and hailed by him, made him proper answer. And the great Rishi then asked him.

sa: सौतिरुवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि महदाख्यानमुत्तमम्। कृष्णद्वैपायनमतं महाभारतमादितः॥
en: Sauti said : I shall recite from the beginning the great and excellent history, called Mahabharata, composed by Krishna Dvaipayana.

sa: महाभागं वसिष्ठं यः पुत्ररिष्टैर्व्ययोजयत्। क्षत्रजातश्च यः पूर्वमभवद् ब्राह्मणो बलात्॥ शौचार्थं यो नदी चक्रे दुर्गमां बहुभिर्जलैः। यां तां पुण्यतमां लोके कौशिकीति विदुर्जनाः॥
en: He made even the illustrious Vasishtha to suffer the grief of the premature death of his sons. He was originally a Kshatriya, but has become a Brahmana by his own strength (of asceticism). He created a deep river of strong currents for the purposes of ablutions. That holy river is still known in the world by the name of Kaushika.

sa: एतया संख्यया ह्यासन्कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः। अक्षौहिण्यो द्विजश्रेष्ठाः पिण्डिताष्टादशैव तु॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, the eighteen Akshauhinis of the Kurus and the Pandava soldiers were composed according to this count.

sa: सभाप्रवेशः कृष्णस्य विदुलापुत्रशासनम्। उद्योग: सैन्यनिर्याणं विश्वोपाख्यानमेव च॥
en: Then the arrival of Krishna at the court, then Vidula-Putra-shasana, then the assemblage of troops and the story of Seta;

sa: समागताश्च वीरेण दृष्टपूर्वाश्च राक्षसाः। बलवन्तो महाकाया निहताश्चाप्यनेकशः॥
en: I had seen before that many powerful and huge Rakshasas came to my son and were killed at his hands.

sa: ततस्ते ज्ञापयामासुधृतराष्ट्रस्य नागराः। पाण्डवानग्निना दग्धानमात्यं च पुरोचनम्॥
en: The citizens then sent words Dhritarashtra to inform that the Pandavas along with counsellor Purochana had been burnt to death.

sa: मन्दपाल उवाच त्वमग्ने सर्वलोकानां मुखं त्वमसि हव्यवाट्॥
en: Mandapala said : O Agni, you are the mouth of all the worlds, you are the carrier of sacrificial ghee.

sa: प्रशस्ताश्चतुरः पूर्वान् ब्राह्मणस्योपधारय। षडानुपूर्व्या क्षत्रस्य विद्धि धाननिन्दिते॥
en: O faultless beauty, know that the first four forms are appropriate to the Brahmanas and the first six for Kshatriyas.

sa: यदाश्रौषं पाण्डवांस्तिष्ठमानान् गत्वा ह्रदे वासुदेवेन सार्धम्। अमर्षणं धर्षयतः सुतं मे तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the Pandavas accompanied by Krishna had gone to the lake and had begun to address my son contemptuously, who was never able to put up with any affront.

sa: तत्रापि जतुगृहे दग्धुं समारब्धा न शकिता विदुरमन्त्रितेनेति॥
en: An attempt was there made to burn them to death, but they were saved through the warning counsel of Vidura.

sa: सौतिरुवाच आस्तीकेनैवमुक्तस्तु राजा पारिक्षितस्तदा। पुनः पुनरुवाचेदमास्तीकं वदतांवरः॥
en: Sautisaid: Thus addressed by Astika, the son of Parikshit (Janamejaya,) again and again said to that best of speakers, Astika,

sa: अथागतास्तमुद्देशं सर्पाः सोमार्थिनस्तदा। स्नाताश्च कृतजप्याश्च प्रहृष्टाः कृतमङ्गलाः॥
en: The snakes, after performing their ablutions, their daily devotions and other sacred rites, came in joy to drink the Ambrosia.

sa: तस्मान्नियमसंयुक्तैः श्रोतव्यं ब्राह्मणैरिदम्। कृष्णप्रोक्तामिमां पुण्यां भारतीमुत्तमां कथाम्॥
en: Therefore, the Brahmanas should hear, with prescribed rules, this holy history, this excellent narration of Bharata, composed by Krishna (Dvaipayana.)

sa: समास्ते चैव मे सर्वे यूयं न संशयः। दीनतो बालतश्चैव स्नेहं कुर्वन्ति मानवाः। तस्मादभ्यधिकः स्नेहो युष्मासु मम साम्प्रतम्॥ स्नेहपूर्वं चिकीर्षामि हितं वस्तन्निबोधत। इदं नगरमभ्याशे रमणीयं निरामयम्। वसतह प्रतिच्छन्ना ममागमनकाक्षिणः॥
en: There is no doubt that you and they all are equal in my eyes; but men love more those that are in misfortune or in tender years. Therefore my love for you is now greater (then before) and in consequence of the love, I wish to do you some good. Listen to me. Not far from this place there is a beautiful town which is a safe place for you. There live you all in disguise, waiting for my return.

sa: एवं संतर्कयामास रूपद्रविणसम्पदा। कन्यामसदृशीं लोके नृपः संवरणस्तदा॥
en: Thus arguing, the king Samvarana considered that maiden as matchless in the wealth of her beauty in the three worlds.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच प्रकाश: च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव। न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति॥
en: The great One said He who has no aversion for knowledge, work or ignorance (the results of the three qualities) when they are present, and he who does not desire them when they are absent, has transcended the three qualities.

sa: जयन्तश्चामितौजाश्च सत्यजिच्च महारथः। महारथा महात्मानः सर्वे पाञ्चालसत्तमाः॥
en: All those best among the Panchalas, namely Jayanta, Amitauja and the mighty carwarrior Satyajit are Maharathas and have great souls.

sa: मुक्तकेशा विकवचा विस्थाश्छिन्नकार्मुकाः। बाहुभिः समयुध्यन्त समवेताः परस्परम्॥
en: Car-warrior, with disheveled hair, with their arrows, swords, and bows severed, fought on with their naked arms meeting one another.

sa: अभ्यायज्जवनैरश्वैः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। महत्या सेनया गुप्तस्तव पुत्रैश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Rushed on the fleetest steed towards the Pandava army, followed by a very large force and by all your sons.

sa: मृदुर्भूत्वा महाराज दारुणः समपद्यता वर्षाभ्यतीतो भगवाञ्छरदीव दिवाकरः॥
en: Mildly; but gradually he grew fierce, O king, like the blazing autumnal Sun at the end of the rainy seasons.

sa: श्वेतच्छत्रसहस्राणि सध्वजाश्च महारथाः। विकीर्णाः समदृश्यन्त शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Thousands of white umbrellas and many mighty car-warriors with their standards, were seen strewn on the surface of the earth.

sa: ततः स कृतवर्माणं मोहयित्वाऽर्जुनः शरैः। अभ्यगाज्जवनैरश्वैः काम्बोजानामानीकिनीम्॥
en: Thereat Arjuna stupefying Kritavarman with his arrows, plunged into the ranks of the Kamboja division, being borne by fleet steeds.

sa: अभिमन्युस्ततः क्रुद्धो नवभिनतपर्वभिः। बिभेद निशितैर्बाणै राक्षसेन्द्र महोरसि॥
en: Thereat Abhimanyu, waxing worth, with nine straight-knotted and whetted shafts, pierced that foremost of the Rakshasas on his broad chest.

sa: समीपे वर्तमानांस्तान् भारद्वाजोऽतिवीर्यवान्। असम्भ्रान्तः शरौघेण महता समवारयत्॥
en: The highly puissant son of Bharadvaja getting the warriors within reach dauntlessly checked them with a mighty downpour of arrows.

sa: सुवर्णवर्णा धर्मज्ञमनीकस्थं युधिष्ठिरम्। राजश्रेष्ठं हयश्रेष्ठाः सर्वतः पृष्ठतोऽन्वयुः॥
en: Excellent steeds of the gold followed behind the virtuous Yudhishthira, that foremost of kings, as he advanced on his car.
